Surah: 10. Follow the brief below (surah_map.md) exactly. The evidence is text.md (the surah), dictionary.md (every root of the surah's words, each branch with the classical dictionaries' own phrases), channels.md and hft.md (both are earlier readers' proposals: ignore their judgements (grades, strength or confidence labels, reading types, statements of what a reading may or may not do) and make your own) and your own knowledge of Arabic and the Quran. Return only the map as your final message.

===== _commentary/v16/prompts/r2/surah_map.md =====
Read the surah as one text and write its map of image chains: the lexical images that run through several of
its ayat and join them into one scene, process or movement. A later writer will read one ayah at a time, with
only that ayah's own dictionary. The map lets that writer hear what the ayah's words carry in the surah as a
whole, including senses whose evidence sits under the words of other ayat.

Your evidence is the surah text, the dictionary of every root in the surah (each branch with the classical
dictionaries' own phrases), earlier readers' channel review (channels.md) and activation hypotheses (hft.md),
and your own knowledge of Arabic and the Quran. Where a member or passage comes from memory rather than from
the dictionary or the text, say so. Do not use tools, delegate, browse or inspect files.

The channel review and the HFT records are proposals by earlier readers. Ignore their judgements: grades,
strength or confidence labels, reading types, words such as "surprising", "exploratory" or "latent", and every
statement of what a reading may or may not do. Make your own judgement from the surah's words, the dictionary
phrases and the Quran. Do not rediscover what they already assembled: start from their chains, test each one
against the dictionary phrases and the text, and join, extend, split or correct them. Where their wording
abstracts a member, go back to the dictionary phrase and name what it actually says.

A chain belongs on the map when its members are senses the dictionary attests for words that stand in the
surah, and together they make one image or process that the surah's wording or sequence lets a listener hear.
A member need not be the sense that translates its word in its own ayah; a chain is heard across the surah,
not in one word. Say plainly when a member is a rare sense or is attested only inside a fixed expression, and
keep it. When the dictionary itself joins two of the surah's words in one phrase, quote that phrase: it is
the strongest evidence a chain can have. Keep a scene at the level of its objects, their parts and their
operation. When proposals share members, do not fold one into another's more abstract function unless nothing
concrete is lost. Carry every chain that meets this test, however unusual; leave out proposals that do not.

Write the map in English, with Arabic quoted exactly (surah wording from the text, dictionary phrases from the
dictionary). It is working material for the writer, not commentary prose.

1. `## Chains`. For each chain, a `###` heading naming the image. One paragraph on what the image is and how it
   moves through the surah. Then its members, one line each: the ayah ref, the word as it stands in the text,
   the root and branch id, the dictionary's own phrase quoted exactly, and what this member contributes to the
   image. Add Quran passages outside the surah, with exact refs, where they stage or confirm the chain.
2. `## Ayat`. For each ayah in order: which chains it opens, advances or completes, and what its words add to
   each.
3. `## Not carried`. Each channel subchannel and each HFT record you did not carry into a chain, one line each:
   its name and why.

No ranking and no labels of strength or confidence. No list of what a writer must include. There is no length
target and no required number of chains or members.


===== _commentary/v16/work/s010/surah.r2/text.md =====
# Surah 10

- 10:1 الٓر ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
- 10:2 أَكَانَ لِلنَّاسِ عَجَبًا أَنْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَنْ أَنذِرِ ٱلنَّاسَ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنَّ لَهُمْ قَدَمَ صِدْقٍ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ۗ قَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
- 10:3 إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۖ يُدَبِّرُ ٱلْأَمْرَ ۖ مَا مِن شَفِيعٍ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ إِذْنِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
- 10:4 إِلَيْهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ جَمِيعًۭا ۖ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقًّا ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَهُمْ شَرَابٌۭ مِّنْ حَمِيمٍۢ وَعَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْفُرُونَ
- 10:5 هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ ضِيَآءًۭ وَٱلْقَمَرَ نُورًۭا وَقَدَّرَهُۥ مَنَازِلَ لِتَعْلَمُوا۟ عَدَدَ ٱلسِّنِينَ وَٱلْحِسَابَ ۚ مَا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ذَٰلِكَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ يُفَصِّلُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لِقَوْمٍۢ يَعْلَمُونَ
- 10:6 إِنَّ فِى ٱخْتِلَٰفِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَتَّقُونَ
- 10:7 إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا وَرَضُوا۟ بِٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱطْمَأَنُّوا۟ بِهَا وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا غَٰفِلُونَ
- 10:8 أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ مَأْوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
- 10:9 إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ يَهْدِيهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِإِيمَٰنِهِمْ ۖ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهِمُ ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ فِى جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
- 10:10 دَعْوَىٰهُمْ فِيهَا سُبْحَٰنَكَ ٱللَّهُمَّ وَتَحِيَّتُهُمْ فِيهَا سَلَٰمٌۭ ۚ وَءَاخِرُ دَعْوَىٰهُمْ أَنِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
- 10:11 ۞ وَلَوْ يُعَجِّلُ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ ٱلشَّرَّ ٱسْتِعْجَالَهُم بِٱلْخَيْرِ لَقُضِىَ إِلَيْهِمْ أَجَلُهُمْ ۖ فَنَذَرُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا فِى طُغْيَٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
- 10:12 وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ ٱلضُّرُّ دَعَانَا لِجَنۢبِهِۦٓ أَوْ قَاعِدًا أَوْ قَآئِمًۭا فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُ ضُرَّهُۥ مَرَّ كَأَن لَّمْ يَدْعُنَآ إِلَىٰ ضُرٍّۢ مَّسَّهُۥ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
- 10:13 وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَا ٱلْقُرُونَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ لَمَّا ظَلَمُوا۟ ۙ وَجَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ لِيُؤْمِنُوا۟ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
- 10:14 ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَٰكُمْ خَلَٰٓئِفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ لِنَنظُرَ كَيْفَ تَعْمَلُونَ
- 10:15 وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَاتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ ۙ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا ٱئْتِ بِقُرْءَانٍ غَيْرِ هَٰذَآ أَوْ بَدِّلْهُ ۚ قُلْ مَا يَكُونُ لِىٓ أَنْ أُبَدِّلَهُۥ مِن تِلْقَآئِ نَفْسِىٓ ۖ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ ۖ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّى عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
- 10:16 قُل لَّوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا تَلَوْتُهُۥ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَآ أَدْرَىٰكُم بِهِۦ ۖ فَقَدْ لَبِثْتُ فِيكُمْ عُمُرًۭا مِّن قَبْلِهِۦٓ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
- 10:17 فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِـَٔايَٰتِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
- 10:18 وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَلَا يَنفَعُهُمْ وَيَقُولُونَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ شُفَعَٰٓؤُنَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَتُنَبِّـُٔونَ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
- 10:19 وَمَا كَانَ ٱلنَّاسُ إِلَّآ أُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ ۚ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌۭ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ فِيمَا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
- 10:20 وَيَقُولُونَ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ ۖ فَقُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْغَيْبُ لِلَّهِ فَٱنتَظِرُوٓا۟ إِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُنتَظِرِينَ
- 10:21 وَإِذَآ أَذَقْنَا ٱلنَّاسَ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنۢ بَعْدِ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتْهُمْ إِذَا لَهُم مَّكْرٌۭ فِىٓ ءَايَاتِنَا ۚ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ أَسْرَعُ مَكْرًا ۚ إِنَّ رُسُلَنَا يَكْتُبُونَ مَا تَمْكُرُونَ
- 10:22 هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُسَيِّرُكُمْ فِى ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا كُنتُمْ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ وَجَرَيْنَ بِهِم بِرِيحٍۢ طَيِّبَةٍۢ وَفَرِحُوا۟ بِهَا جَآءَتْهَا رِيحٌ عَاصِفٌۭ وَجَآءَهُمُ ٱلْمَوْجُ مِن كُلِّ مَكَانٍۢ وَظَنُّوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ أُحِيطَ بِهِمْ ۙ دَعَوُا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ لَئِنْ أَنجَيْتَنَا مِنْ هَٰذِهِۦ لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلشَّٰكِرِينَ
- 10:23 فَلَمَّآ أَنجَىٰهُمْ إِذَا هُمْ يَبْغُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ ۗ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّمَا بَغْيُكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِكُم ۖ مَّتَٰعَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَنُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
- 10:24 إِنَّمَا مَثَلُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا كَمَآءٍ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَٱخْتَلَطَ بِهِۦ نَبَاتُ ٱلْأَرْضِ مِمَّا يَأْكُلُ ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱلْأَنْعَٰمُ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَخَذَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زُخْرُفَهَا وَٱزَّيَّنَتْ وَظَنَّ أَهْلُهَآ أَنَّهُمْ قَٰدِرُونَ عَلَيْهَآ أَتَىٰهَآ أَمْرُنَا لَيْلًا أَوْ نَهَارًۭا فَجَعَلْنَٰهَا حَصِيدًۭا كَأَن لَّمْ تَغْنَ بِٱلْأَمْسِ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لِقَوْمٍۢ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
- 10:25 وَٱللَّهُ يَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ دَارِ ٱلسَّلَٰمِ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
- 10:26 ۞ لِّلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ وَزِيَادَةٌۭ ۖ وَلَا يَرْهَقُ وُجُوهَهُمْ قَتَرٌۭ وَلَا ذِلَّةٌ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
- 10:27 وَٱلَّذِينَ كَسَبُوا۟ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ جَزَآءُ سَيِّئَةٍۭ بِمِثْلِهَا وَتَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌۭ ۖ مَّا لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِنْ عَاصِمٍۢ ۖ كَأَنَّمَآ أُغْشِيَتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ قِطَعًۭا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مُظْلِمًا ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
- 10:28 وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًۭا ثُمَّ نَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا۟ مَكَانَكُمْ أَنتُمْ وَشُرَكَآؤُكُمْ ۚ فَزَيَّلْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ شُرَكَآؤُهُم مَّا كُنتُمْ إِيَّانَا تَعْبُدُونَ
- 10:29 فَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًۢا بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ إِن كُنَّا عَنْ عِبَادَتِكُمْ لَغَٰفِلِينَ
- 10:30 هُنَالِكَ تَبْلُوا۟ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّآ أَسْلَفَتْ ۚ وَرُدُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَوْلَىٰهُمُ ٱلْحَقِّ ۖ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
- 10:31 قُلْ مَن يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أَمَّن يَمْلِكُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَمَن يُخْرِجُ ٱلْحَىَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَيِّتِ وَيُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَيِّتَ مِنَ ٱلْحَىِّ وَمَن يُدَبِّرُ ٱلْأَمْرَ ۚ فَسَيَقُولُونَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ فَقُلْ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
- 10:32 فَذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَاذَا بَعْدَ ٱلْحَقِّ إِلَّا ٱلضَّلَٰلُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصْرَفُونَ
- 10:33 كَذَٰلِكَ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ فَسَقُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
- 10:34 قُلْ هَلْ مِن شُرَكَآئِكُم مَّن يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ ۚ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ
- 10:35 قُلْ هَلْ مِن شُرَكَآئِكُم مَّن يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلْحَقِّ ۚ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يَهْدِى لِلْحَقِّ ۗ أَفَمَن يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلْحَقِّ أَحَقُّ أَن يُتَّبَعَ أَمَّن لَّا يَهِدِّىٓ إِلَّآ أَن يُهْدَىٰ ۖ فَمَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
- 10:36 وَمَا يَتَّبِعُ أَكْثَرُهُمْ إِلَّا ظَنًّا ۚ إِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًٔا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ
- 10:37 وَمَا كَانَ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ أَن يُفْتَرَىٰ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَٰكِن تَصْدِيقَ ٱلَّذِى بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَتَفْصِيلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ مِن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
- 10:38 أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ ۖ قُلْ فَأْتُوا۟ بِسُورَةٍۢ مِّثْلِهِۦ وَٱدْعُوا۟ مَنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
- 10:39 بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِمَا لَمْ يُحِيطُوا۟ بِعِلْمِهِۦ وَلَمَّا يَأْتِهِمْ تَأْوِيلُهُۥ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۖ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
- 10:40 وَمِنْهُم مَّن يُؤْمِنُ بِهِۦ وَمِنْهُم مَّن لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِهِۦ ۚ وَرَبُّكَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
- 10:41 وَإِن كَذَّبُوكَ فَقُل لِّى عَمَلِى وَلَكُمْ عَمَلُكُمْ ۖ أَنتُم بَرِيٓـُٔونَ مِمَّآ أَعْمَلُ وَأَنَا۠ بَرِىٓءٌۭ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
- 10:42 وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَسْتَمِعُونَ إِلَيْكَ ۚ أَفَأَنتَ تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ وَلَوْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
- 10:43 وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَنظُرُ إِلَيْكَ ۚ أَفَأَنتَ تَهْدِى ٱلْعُمْىَ وَلَوْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ
- 10:44 إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَظْلِمُ ٱلنَّاسَ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
- 10:45 وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ كَأَن لَّمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا سَاعَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلنَّهَارِ يَتَعَارَفُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ قَدْ خَسِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُهْتَدِينَ
- 10:46 وَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ ثُمَّ ٱللَّهُ شَهِيدٌ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ
- 10:47 وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍۢ رَّسُولٌۭ ۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ رَسُولُهُمْ قُضِىَ بَيْنَهُم بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
- 10:48 وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
- 10:49 قُل لَّآ أَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِى ضَرًّۭا وَلَا نَفْعًا إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۗ لِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلٌ ۚ إِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ سَاعَةًۭ ۖ وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ
- 10:50 قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَتَىٰكُمْ عَذَابُهُۥ بَيَٰتًا أَوْ نَهَارًۭا مَّاذَا يَسْتَعْجِلُ مِنْهُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
- 10:51 أَثُمَّ إِذَا مَا وَقَعَ ءَامَنتُم بِهِۦٓ ۚ ءَآلْـَٰٔنَ وَقَدْ كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
- 10:52 ثُمَّ قِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلْخُلْدِ هَلْ تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ
- 10:53 ۞ وَيَسْتَنۢبِـُٔونَكَ أَحَقٌّ هُوَ ۖ قُلْ إِى وَرَبِّىٓ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّۭ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ
- 10:54 وَلَوْ أَنَّ لِكُلِّ نَفْسٍۢ ظَلَمَتْ مَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لَٱفْتَدَتْ بِهِۦ ۗ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ۖ وَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُم بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۚ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
- 10:55 أَلَآ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
- 10:56 هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
- 10:57 يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ قَدْ جَآءَتْكُم مَّوْعِظَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَشِفَآءٌۭ لِّمَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ وَهُدًۭى وَرَحْمَةٌۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
- 10:58 قُلْ بِفَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ وَبِرَحْمَتِهِۦ فَبِذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَفْرَحُوا۟ هُوَ خَيْرٌۭ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ
- 10:59 قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُم مِّن رِّزْقٍۢ فَجَعَلْتُم مِّنْهُ حَرَامًۭا وَحَلَٰلًۭا قُلْ ءَآللَّهُ أَذِنَ لَكُمْ ۖ أَمْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ تَفْتَرُونَ
- 10:60 وَمَا ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ
- 10:61 وَمَا تَكُونُ فِى شَأْنٍۢ وَمَا تَتْلُوا۟ مِنْهُ مِن قُرْءَانٍۢ وَلَا تَعْمَلُونَ مِنْ عَمَلٍ إِلَّا كُنَّا عَلَيْكُمْ شُهُودًا إِذْ تُفِيضُونَ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَا يَعْزُبُ عَن رَّبِّكَ مِن مِّثْقَالِ ذَرَّةٍۢ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَلَآ أَصْغَرَ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَآ أَكْبَرَ إِلَّا فِى كِتَٰبٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
- 10:62 أَلَآ إِنَّ أَوْلِيَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
- 10:63 ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ يَتَّقُونَ
- 10:64 لَهُمُ ٱلْبُشْرَىٰ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَفِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۚ لَا تَبْدِيلَ لِكَلِمَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
- 10:65 وَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّ ٱلْعِزَّةَ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعًا ۚ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
- 10:66 أَلَآ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَمَا يَتَّبِعُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَإِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ
- 10:67 هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ لِتَسْكُنُوا۟ فِيهِ وَٱلنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَسْمَعُونَ
- 10:68 قَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَدًۭا ۗ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ ۖ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ۖ لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنْ عِندَكُم مِّن سُلْطَٰنٍۭ بِهَٰذَآ ۚ أَتَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
- 10:69 قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ لَا يُفْلِحُونَ
- 10:70 مَتَٰعٌۭ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ ثُمَّ نُذِيقُهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلشَّدِيدَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْفُرُونَ
- 10:71 ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ نُوحٍ إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦ يَٰقَوْمِ إِن كَانَ كَبُرَ عَلَيْكُم مَّقَامِى وَتَذْكِيرِى بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ فَأَجْمِعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَكُمْ وَشُرَكَآءَكُمْ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُنْ أَمْرُكُمْ عَلَيْكُمْ غُمَّةًۭ ثُمَّ ٱقْضُوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ وَلَا تُنظِرُونِ
- 10:72 فَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَمَا سَأَلْتُكُم مِّنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
- 10:73 فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ وَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ خَلَٰٓئِفَ وَأَغْرَقْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا ۖ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
- 10:74 ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ رُسُلًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِمْ فَجَآءُوهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَمَا كَانُوا۟ لِيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِمَا كَذَّبُوا۟ بِهِۦ مِن قَبْلُ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَطْبَعُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُعْتَدِينَ
- 10:75 ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِم مُّوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا مُّجْرِمِينَ
- 10:76 فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِنْ عِندِنَا قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
- 10:77 قَالَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَتَقُولُونَ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَكُمْ ۖ أَسِحْرٌ هَٰذَا وَلَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلسَّٰحِرُونَ
- 10:78 قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَلْفِتَنَا عَمَّا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَنَا وَتَكُونَ لَكُمَا ٱلْكِبْرِيَآءُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا نَحْنُ لَكُمَا بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
- 10:79 وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱئْتُونِى بِكُلِّ سَٰحِرٍ عَلِيمٍۢ
- 10:80 فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
- 10:81 فَلَمَّآ أَلْقَوْا۟ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ مَا جِئْتُم بِهِ ٱلسِّحْرُ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَيُبْطِلُهُۥٓ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُصْلِحُ عَمَلَ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
- 10:82 وَيُحِقُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَٰتِهِۦ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
- 10:83 فَمَآ ءَامَنَ لِمُوسَىٰٓ إِلَّا ذُرِّيَّةٌۭ مِّن قَوْمِهِۦ عَلَىٰ خَوْفٍۢ مِّن فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِمْ أَن يَفْتِنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ لَعَالٍۢ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
- 10:84 وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ يَٰقَوْمِ إِن كُنتُمْ ءَامَنتُم بِٱللَّهِ فَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلُوٓا۟ إِن كُنتُم مُّسْلِمِينَ
- 10:85 فَقَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
- 10:86 وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
- 10:87 وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَأَخِيهِ أَن تَبَوَّءَا لِقَوْمِكُمَا بِمِصْرَ بُيُوتًۭا وَٱجْعَلُوا۟ بُيُوتَكُمْ قِبْلَةًۭ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
- 10:88 وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ ءَاتَيْتَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَأَهُۥ زِينَةًۭ وَأَمْوَٰلًۭا فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا رَبَّنَا لِيُضِلُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِكَ ۖ رَبَّنَا ٱطْمِسْ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَٱشْدُدْ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَلَا يُؤْمِنُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
- 10:89 قَالَ قَدْ أُجِيبَت دَّعْوَتُكُمَا فَٱسْتَقِيمَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعَآنِّ سَبِيلَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
- 10:90 ۞ وَجَٰوَزْنَا بِبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلْبَحْرَ فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ وَجُنُودُهُۥ بَغْيًۭا وَعَدْوًا ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَدْرَكَهُ ٱلْغَرَقُ قَالَ ءَامَنتُ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِىٓ ءَامَنَتْ بِهِۦ بَنُوٓا۟ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
- 10:91 ءَآلْـَٰٔنَ وَقَدْ عَصَيْتَ قَبْلُ وَكُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
- 10:92 فَٱلْيَوْمَ نُنَجِّيكَ بِبَدَنِكَ لِتَكُونَ لِمَنْ خَلْفَكَ ءَايَةًۭ ۚ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ عَنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا لَغَٰفِلُونَ
- 10:93 وَلَقَدْ بَوَّأْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مُبَوَّأَ صِدْقٍۢ وَرَزَقْنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ فَمَا ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِى بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
- 10:94 فَإِن كُنتَ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّمَّآ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ فَسْـَٔلِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَقْرَءُونَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِن قَبْلِكَ ۚ لَقَدْ جَآءَكَ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُمْتَرِينَ
- 10:95 وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ
- 10:96 إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ حَقَّتْ عَلَيْهِمْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
- 10:97 وَلَوْ جَآءَتْهُمْ كُلُّ ءَايَةٍ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
- 10:98 فَلَوْلَا كَانَتْ قَرْيَةٌ ءَامَنَتْ فَنَفَعَهَآ إِيمَٰنُهَآ إِلَّا قَوْمَ يُونُسَ لَمَّآ ءَامَنُوا۟ كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْخِزْىِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمَتَّعْنَٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
- 10:99 وَلَوْ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ لَءَامَنَ مَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ كُلُّهُمْ جَمِيعًا ۚ أَفَأَنتَ تُكْرِهُ ٱلنَّاسَ حَتَّىٰ يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
- 10:100 وَمَا كَانَ لِنَفْسٍ أَن تُؤْمِنَ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَيَجْعَلُ ٱلرِّجْسَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
- 10:101 قُلِ ٱنظُرُوا۟ مَاذَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَمَا تُغْنِى ٱلْءَايَٰتُ وَٱلنُّذُرُ عَن قَوْمٍۢ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
- 10:102 فَهَلْ يَنتَظِرُونَ إِلَّا مِثْلَ أَيَّامِ ٱلَّذِينَ خَلَوْا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ قُلْ فَٱنتَظِرُوٓا۟ إِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُنتَظِرِينَ
- 10:103 ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى رُسُلَنَا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ حَقًّا عَلَيْنَا نُنجِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
- 10:104 قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِن كُنتُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّن دِينِى فَلَآ أَعْبُدُ ٱلَّذِينَ تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَٰكِنْ أَعْبُدُ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى يَتَوَفَّىٰكُمْ ۖ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
- 10:105 وَأَنْ أَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفًۭا وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
- 10:106 وَلَا تَدْعُ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكَ وَلَا يَضُرُّكَ ۖ فَإِن فَعَلْتَ فَإِنَّكَ إِذًۭا مِّنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
- 10:107 وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّۢ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُۥٓ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ وَإِن يُرِدْكَ بِخَيْرٍۢ فَلَا رَآدَّ لِفَضْلِهِۦ ۚ يُصِيبُ بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
- 10:108 قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ قَدْ جَآءَكُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ ۖ فَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِى لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا ۖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ عَلَيْكُم بِوَكِيلٍۢ
- 10:109 وَٱتَّبِعْ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ وَٱصْبِرْ حَتَّىٰ يَحْكُمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ

# Dictionary: every branch of every focus root

Every root of the surah's words, each once, headed by the ayah and word where it first occurs; it also serves the later words listed with it.
One entry per branch: a Turkish label and Turkish glosses of its attested senses, then the classical dictionaries' own phrases with their source tags (ayn, sihah, tahdhib, maqayis, mufradat, jamhara). [kalıp] marks a sense the dictionaries attest only inside a fixed expression.
Identity roots come from the quran-data gateway. Word-scoped alternatives are cited analyses of this
exact word. **Echo roots** are observed but withheld mappings: sound-family candidates, not identity.

## ء ي ي (root_000074): 10:1 ءَايَٰتُ, 10:5 ٱلْءَايَٰتِ, 10:6 لَءَايَٰتٍ, 10:7 ءَايَٰتِنَا, 10:15 ءَايَاتُنَا, 10:17 بِـَٔايَٰتِهِۦٓ, 10:20 ءَايَةٌ, 10:21 ءَايَاتِنَا, 10:24 ٱلْءَايَٰتِ, 10:67 لَءَايَٰتٍ, 10:71 بِـَٔايَٰتِ, 10:73 بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا, 10:75 بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا, 10:92 ءَايَةً, 10:92 ءَايَٰتِنَا, 10:95 بِـَٔايَٰتِ, 10:97 ءَايَةٍ, 10:101 ٱلْءَايَٰتُ

- **B003** gorunen belirti — gorunen isaret · belirlenmis isaret · kisinin sahsi · topluca cikmak · kitaptaki harf toplulugu parcasi · gunesin isigi · gunesin isigi
  الآية العلامة؛ آية الرجل شخصه؛ خرج القوم بآيتهم أي بجماعتهم؛ آية القرآن لأنها جماعة حروف؛ إياة الشمس ضوءها لأنه كالعلامة لها (maqayis)؛ الآية العلامة والآية من آيات الله والجميع الآي (ayn)؛ الآية العلامة؛ آية الرجل شخصه؛ خرج القوم بآيتهم أي بجماعتهم؛ الآية من كتاب الله جماعة حروف؛ أياة الشمس ضوؤها (sihah)
- **B004** hangi belirleyicisi — soru, sart veya ilgiyle belirleyen ad · hangi olursa veya herhangi bir

- **B005** nesne zamiri dayanagi — nesne zamiri icin dayanak unsur

- **B006** zaman sorusu — ne zaman anlaminda zaman sorusu

# s010 Semantic Channel Discovery

## Parent Channels

### 1. P1 - Reality Made Legible
- Semantic invariant: Reality becomes intelligible by being inscribed, distinguished, and measured.
- Surface relation: direct; 10:1 (ءَايَٰتُ، كِتَٰبِ، حَكِيمِ), 10:5-6 (شَّمْسَ، ضِيَآءً، قَمَرَ، نُورًا، حِسَابَ، سِّنِينَ، يُفَصِّلُ، ٱخْتِلَٰفِ).
- Surprising reach: The written page and the alternating sky function as parallel instruments of exact disclosure.

#### Subchannel A. Inscription as Precise Disclosure
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: A written object presents visible signs whose parts are disclosed with wisdom and exact construction.
- Active motifs: written text (quranic:root_001283:B002/m01); visible sign (quranic:root_000074:B003/m01); accurate wisdom (quranic:root_000348:B003/m01); exact construction (quranic:root_000348:B004/m01); articulated detail (quranic:root_001159:B013/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:1 (ءَايَٰتُ، كِتَٰبِ، حَكِيمِ); 10:5 (يُفَصِّلُ).
- Synthesis: The opening treats scripture not as an undifferentiated message but as an artifact whose signs have been written, made visible, accurately judged, and fitted together. The lexical imagery of construction and articulation makes wisdom a property of how disclosure is formed.

#### Subchannel B. Celestial Calibration
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Sun, moon, radiance, and light are assigned magnitudes and alternating periods from which counted time is recovered.
- Active motifs: sun (quranic:root_000818:B001/m01); diffused radiance (quranic:root_000919:B001/m01); moon (quranic:root_001255:B001/m01); illumination (quranic:root_001564:B001/m01); measured limit (quranic:root_001205:B001/m01); enumeration (quranic:root_000989:B001/m01); year (quranic:root_000751:B008/m01); succession by alternation (quranic:root_000433:B006/m01); night (quranic:root_001392:B001/m01); daylight opening (quranic:root_001559:B002/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:5 (شَّمْسَ، ضِيَآءً، قَمَرَ، نُورًا، قَدَّرَ، عَدَدَ، سِّنِينَ); 10:6 (ٱخْتِلَٰفِ، يْلِ، نَّهَارِ).
- Synthesis: The sky operates as a calibrated display: distinct luminous bodies, assigned measures, counted years, and the succession of night and day form a legible temporal mechanism. Its latent kinship with inscription lies in ordered distinction rather than mere visibility.

### 2. P1 - Transmission Held to Its Course
- Semantic invariant: A received discourse remains authoritative by preserving its sequence, source, and form.
- Surface relation: direct; 10:2 (أَوْحَيْ), 10:15-17 (تُتْلَىٰ، أَتَّبِعُ، يُوحَىٰٓ، بَدِّلْ، ٱفْتَرَىٰ، كَذِبًا).
- Surprising reach: Fidelity is rendered both as following a recited sequence and as refusing to refashion an artifact.

#### Subchannel A. Received Sequence and Recited Following
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Speech is received from beyond the speaker, recited in sequence, and followed rather than generated from the speaker's own position.
- Active motifs: divine communication (quranic:root_001633:B004/m01); reading and recitation (quranic:root_001210:B002/m01); serial following (quranic:root_000186:B001/m01); following behind (quranic:root_000175:B001/m01); receiving speech (quranic:root_001372:B011/m01); verbal clarification (quranic:root_000170:B005/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:2 (أَوْحَيْ); 10:15 (تُتْلَىٰ، أَتَّبِعُ، يُوحَىٰٓ); 10:16 (تَلَوْ).
- Synthesis: Revelation moves through a chain of reception, recitation, and following. The sequence itself constrains the messenger: clarification may expose what is given, but it cannot relocate authorship into the reciter.

#### Subchannel B. Substitution and Counterfeit Form
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Demands to replace or reshape the recitation are answered by distinguishing authorized transmission from fabricated or deceptive production.
- Active motifs: one thing standing in another's place (quranic:root_000095:B001/m01); alteration of form (quranic:root_000095:B002/m01); changing a thing for another (quranic:root_001119:B003/m01); fabricated falsehood (quranic:root_001150:B003/m01); contradiction of truth (quranic:root_001290:B001/m01); deceptive diversion (quranic:root_000682:B002/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:2 (سَٰحِرٌ); 10:15 (غَيْرِ، بَدِّلْ، أُبَدِّلَ); 10:17 (ٱفْتَرَىٰ، كَذِبًا، كَذَّبَ).
- Synthesis: Replacement, formal alteration, invention, and deceptive diversion constitute distinct counterfeit operations around the same received discourse. Their clustering sharpens the refusal to substitute: the issue is not stylistic preference but preservation of provenance.

### 3. P1 - Return as Exact Settlement
- Semantic invariant: What is originated is brought back into an ordered encounter with the consequences of action.
- Surface relation: direct; 10:4 (يَبْدَؤُا۟، يُعِيدُ، مَرْجِعُ، يَجْزِىَ، قِسْطِ، عَذَابٌ، حَمِيمٍ، شَرَابٌ).
- Surprising reach: Cosmic return contracts into bodily contact through drink, heat, and pain.

#### Subchannel A. Origination Folded into Return
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Creation begins, departs, and is restored, gathering multiplicity back toward one destination.
- Active motifs: origination of creation (quranic:root_000434:B002/m01); beginning joined to recurrence (quranic:root_000090:B002/m01); return after departure (quranic:root_001058:B001/m01); restoration to a prior state (quranic:root_000544:B001/m01); gathering the dispersed (quranic:root_000259:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:4 (خَلْقَ، يَبْدَؤُا۟، يُعِيدُ، مَرْجِعُ، جَمِيعًا).
- Synthesis: Beginning and return are one closed movement. The gathering motif gives the return a spatial force: what appears dispersed in created life is collected again at a common terminus.

#### Subchannel B. Apportioned Consequence Becomes Ingestion
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Actions receive a truthful and equitable counterpart, while punishment becomes a hot liquid taken into the body.
- Active motifs: reality-conforming truth (quranic:root_000347:B001/m01); equity (quranic:root_001224:B001/m01); action met by its recompense (quranic:root_000244:B001/m01); intentional deed (quranic:root_001046:B001/m01); punitive pain (quranic:root_000994:B005/m01); hot water and washing (quranic:root_000001:B002/m01); drinking liquid (quranic:root_000783:B001/m01); felt pain (quranic:root_000046:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:4 (حَقًّا، قِسْطِ، يَجْزِىَ، عَمِلُ، عَذَابٌ، حَمِيمٍ، شَرَابٌ، أَلِيمٌۢ).
- Synthesis: Settlement is not left as an abstract equivalence. Justice pairs deed and consequence, then the lexical field materializes that pairing as a drink whose heat and pain enter the recipient.

### 4. P2 - Water Changes the State of a Scene
- Semantic invariant: Water carries a scene from apparent security or flourishing into exposure, sorting, and irreversible outcome.
- Surface relation: direct; 10:22-24 (بَحْرِ، فُلْكِ، رِيحٍ، مَوْجُ، أُحِيطَ، أَنجَيْ، مَآءٍ، ٱخْتَلَطَ، نَبَاتُ، حَصِيدًا).
- Surprising reach: Maritime enclosure and agricultural saturation are opposite water motions that reveal the same instability of human possession.

#### Subchannel A. Vessel Under Encirclement
- Reading type: surface-primary
- Scene or process: A ship moves over wide water under a favorable wind, is struck by violent wind and interlocking waves, becomes enclosed, and is released through rescue.
- Active motifs: wide sea (quranic:root_000086:B001/m01); ship moving in water (quranic:root_001177:B003/m01); flowing motion (quranic:root_000240:B001/m01); wind (quranic:root_000609:B003/m01); violent scattering wind (quranic:root_001020:B002/m01); interlocking wave-motion (quranic:root_001455:B001/m01); physical encirclement (quranic:root_000372:B001/m01); crisis call (quranic:root_000478:B001/m01); exclusive devotion (quranic:root_000430:B004/m01); escape by separation (quranic:root_001476:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:22 (بَحْرِ، فُلْكِ، جَرَيْ، رِيحٍ، عَاصِفٌ، مَوْجُ، أُحِيطَ، دَعَ، مُخْلِصِينَ، أَنجَيْ).
- Synthesis: The vessel scene is a complete pressure cycle. Smooth transport becomes turbulent enclosure; enclosure concentrates devotion; rescue separates the passengers from the enclosing medium. Water here tests the stability of allegiance.

#### Subchannel B. Saturation, Adornment, and Harvest
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Descending water mixes with soil, produces edible growth, reaches ornamental fullness, and is cut down as though the flourishing had never occupied the place.
- Active motifs: water (quranic:root_001458:B001/m01); delivery by descent (quranic:root_001492:B002/m01); mixing (quranic:root_000431:B001/m01); sprouting plant (quranic:root_001465:B001/m01); crop yield (quranic:root_000043:B002/m01); ornamentation (quranic:root_000628:B001/m01); beautifying display (quranic:root_000660:B002/m01); cutting the crop (quranic:root_000327:B001/m01); night (quranic:root_001392:B001/m01); daylight opening (quranic:root_001559:B002/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:24 (مَآءٍ، أَنزَلْ، ٱخْتَلَطَ، نَبَاتُ، يَأْكُلُ، زُخْرُفَ، ٱزَّيَّنَتْ، حَصِيدًا، لَيْلًا، نَهَارًا).
- Synthesis: The field is built as a temporal machine: water penetrates and mixes, growth becomes food and display, then cutting converts fullness into absence. Night and day mark how quickly the completed scene can be rewritten.

### 5. P2 - Consequence Written on the Face
- Semantic invariant: Outcome becomes a visible layer on the face, either withheld or imposed.
- Surface relation: direct; 10:26-27 (وُجُوهَ، قَتَرٌ، ذِلَّةٌ، تَرْهَقُ، أُغْشِيَتْ، قِطَعًا، يْلِ).
- Surprising reach: Moral result is rendered as surface treatment: dust, covering, and cut night-material alter the face.

#### Subchannel A. The Face Without Overlay
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Good action receives increase and durable enclosure while dust and humiliating overlay fail to take hold of the face.
- Active motifs: beauty against ugliness (quranic:root_000323:B001/m01); good action (quranic:root_000323:B002/m01); increase (quranic:root_000657:B001/m01); face-dust (quranic:root_001199:B004/m01); overpowering overlay (quranic:root_000606:B001/m01); subjection under force (quranic:root_000519:B001/m01); hidden garden (quranic:root_000266:B003/m01); lasting permanence (quranic:root_000429:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:26 (أَحْسَنُ، حُسْنَىٰ، زِيَادَةٌ، قَتَرٌ، يَرْهَقُ، ذِلَّةٌ، جَنَّةِ، خَٰلِدُونَ، وُجُوهَ).
- Synthesis: The favorable outcome is described partly by what cannot adhere. The face remains free of dust and coercive covering, while the recipient passes into concealed, lasting growth; exterior clarity and protected interiority answer one another.

#### Subchannel B. Night Applied in Pieces
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Acquired badness is repaid by a cover that settles on faces like separated pieces of night, with no restraining protector.
- Active motifs: badness (quranic:root_000755:B001/m01); acquired gain (quranic:root_001296:B001/m01); deed met by recompense (quranic:root_000244:B001/m01); face (quranic:root_001630:B001/m01); covering layer (quranic:root_001088:B001/m01); separated piece (quranic:root_001240:B002/m01); night and its darkness (quranic:root_001392:B001/m01); restraint that protects (quranic:root_001021:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:27 (سَّيِّـَٔاتِ، كَسَبُ، جَزَآءُ، وُجُوهُ، أُغْشِيَتْ، قِطَعًا، يْلِ، عَاصِمٍ).
- Synthesis: The result of action becomes a fabricated surface: night is imagined as divisible material placed over the face. The absence of a restraining protector makes the covering final rather than cosmetic.

### 6. P2 - Recitation Tests Provenance
- Semantic invariant: A discourse exposes its origin through confirmation, bounded imitation, and the temporal completion of knowledge.
- Surface relation: direct; 10:37-40 (قُرْءَانُ، كِتَٰبِ، تَصْدِيقَ، تَفْصِيلَ، سُورَةٍ، ٱفْتَرَىٰ، يُحِيطُ، عِلْمِ، تَأْوِيلُ، كَذَّبُ).
- Surprising reach: Provenance is tested not only by content but by whether a rival can assemble a bounded counterpart and survive its eventual outcome.

#### Subchannel A. Confirmation and Articulated Detail
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: The recitation joins written material, confirms what precedes it, and separates its contents into intelligible detail without fabrication.
- Active motifs: reading and recitation (quranic:root_001210:B002/m01); written text (quranic:root_001283:B002/m01); joining one thing to another (quranic:root_001283:B001/m01); truthful speech (quranic:root_000852:B001/m01); articulated detail (quranic:root_001159:B013/m01); destabilizing doubt (quranic:root_000616:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:37 (قُرْءَانُ، كِتَٰبِ، تَصْدِيقَ، يَدَيْ، تَفْصِيلَ، رَيْبَ).
- Synthesis: Confirmation is an assembly operation: recitation joins a written continuum already in motion, while detail separates that continuum into meaningful parts. The paired motions of joining and articulation answer doubt through structure.

#### Subchannel B. The Bounded Counterpart Challenge
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: A claim of fabrication is tested by calling collaborators to produce one comparable, bounded unit from elsewhere.
- Active motifs: fabricated falsehood (quranic:root_001150:B003/m01); an enclosed elevated piece (quranic:root_000758:B003/m01); likeness (quranic:root_001397:B001/m01); summoning by call (quranic:root_000478:B001/m01); other-than (quranic:root_000502:B003/m01); truthful correspondence (quranic:root_000852:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:38 (ٱفْتَرَىٰ، سُورَةٍ، مِّثْلِ، ٱدْعُ، دُونِ، صَٰدِقِينَ).
- Synthesis: The challenge does not ask for a vague rival discourse. It specifies a bounded piece, a relation of likeness, and summoned outside assistance, turning the fabrication charge into a reproducible production test.

#### Subchannel C. Denial Before Encompassment
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Denial occurs before knowledge has enclosed the object and before its interpretation has reached its outcome.
- Active motifs: complete cognitive encompassment (quranic:root_000372:B004/m01); disclosed knowledge (quranic:root_001040:B001/m01); return to final outcome (quranic:root_000067:B002/m01); false denial (quranic:root_001290:B001/m01); directed inspection (quranic:root_001520:B001/m01); corruption from proper order (quranic:root_001154:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:39 (يُحِيطُ، عِلْمِ، تَأْوِيلُ، كَذَّبُ، ٱنظُرْ); 10:40 (مُفْسِدِينَ).
- Synthesis: Premature denial is a timing failure. Judgment is issued before knowledge has enclosed the matter and before the matter has returned to its interpretable end; the command to look reopens the sequence that denial cut short.

### 7. P2 - False Partnerships Disassembled
- Semantic invariant: An alleged shared order is gathered, separated into its real parties, and returned to true ownership.
- Surface relation: direct; 10:28-30 (نَحْشُرُ، جَمِيعًا، زَيَّلْ، شُرَكَآؤُ، بَيْنَ، شَهِيدًۢا، تَبْلُوا۟، رُدُّ، مَوْلَىٰ).
- Surprising reach: Judgment resembles disassembly: a composite social object is taken apart until every claimed connection can be tested.

#### Subchannel A. Crowd Gathered, Partners Separated
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: A crowd is driven together, then alleged partners are distinguished from their worshippers under witnessed separation.
- Active motifs: driving a group to one destination (quranic:root_000324:B001/m01); gathering the dispersed (quranic:root_000259:B001/m01); separating and distinguishing (quranic:root_000659:B001/m01); religious association (quranic:root_000791:B002/m01); separation between parties (quranic:root_000170:B001/m01); witnessed presence (quranic:root_000822:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:28 (نَحْشُرُ، جَمِيعًا، زَيَّلْ، أَشْرَكُ، شُرَكَآؤُ، بَيْنَ); 10:29 (شَهِيدًۢا، بَيْنَ).
- Synthesis: Gathering does not preserve the claimed collective. It creates the condition for exact separation, after which the partnership can no longer hide inside a crowd and each side must occupy its own witnessed position.

#### Subchannel B. Each Self Returned to Its Master
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Each self undergoes disclosure of what it sent ahead, is returned to the true one who held its affair, and loses its inventions.
- Active motifs: testing that reveals condition (quranic:root_000153:B002/m01); the self as the thing itself (quranic:root_001533:B012/m01); prior sending (quranic:root_000733:B001/m01); being sent back (quranic:root_000555:B001/m01); governance of an affair (quranic:root_001684:B003/m01); reality-conforming truth (quranic:root_000347:B001/m01); loss of the object (quranic:root_000913:B003/m01); fabricated falsehood (quranic:root_001150:B003/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:30 (تَبْلُوا۟، نَفْسٍ، أَسْلَفَتْ، رُدُّ، مَوْلَىٰ، حَقِّ، ضَلَّ، يَفْتَرُ).
- Synthesis: The test is also a return of custody. Prior action is exposed, the self is restored to its actual governor, and fabricated attachments disappear because they cannot survive the change in ownership.

### 8. P2 - Provision and Life Are Routed
- Semantic invariant: Sustenance and vitality arrive through owned channels whose inputs, organs, transfers, and administration remain coordinated.
- Surface relation: direct; 10:31 (يَرْزُقُ، سَّمْعَ، أَبْصَٰرَ، يُخْرِجُ، حَىِّ، مَيِّتِ، يَمْلِكُ، يُدَبِّرُ).
- Surprising reach: Provision is less a stored commodity than a routed system joining environment, sensory intake, and life exchange.

#### Subchannel A. Inputs and Sensory Gates
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Apportioned sustenance descends from above and rises from below while hearing and sight receive the world through distinct bodily gates.
- Active motifs: apportioned gift (quranic:root_000560:B001/m01); nourishing food (quranic:root_000560:B002/m01); overhanging sky (quranic:root_000745:B004/m01); earth below (quranic:root_000025:B001/m01); organ of hearing (quranic:root_000741:B002/m01); eyesight (quranic:root_000121:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:31 (يَرْزُقُ، سَّمَآءِ، أَرْضِ، سَّمْعَ، أَبْصَٰرَ).
- Synthesis: Above and below provide environmental inputs, while ear and eye are receiving apertures. The provision question therefore expands into an anatomy of dependence: nourishment and perception both require channels one does not own.

#### Subchannel B. Extraction and Government of Life
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Living and dead states are extracted from one another under possession and forward-looking administration.
- Active motifs: emergence to the outside (quranic:root_000400:B001/m01); bringing out from concealment (quranic:root_000400:B002/m01); living being (quranic:root_000383:B003/m01); loss of life (quranic:root_001454:B001/m01); ownership and disposal (quranic:root_001444:B002/m01); administration by considering outcome (quranic:root_000458:B006/m01); affair or state (quranic:root_000051:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:31 (يُخْرِجُ، حَىَّ، حَىِّ، مَيِّتِ، مَيِّتَ، يَمْلِكُ، يُدَبِّرُ، أَمْرَ).
- Synthesis: Life exchange is described as controlled extraction rather than spontaneous appearance. Ownership and administration frame the alternating transfers, making vitality part of a governed flow whose outcome is already considered.

### 9. P2 - Causal Priority Governs Guidance
- Semantic invariant: A true guide must stand causally prior to both the created path and the act of being guided.
- Surface relation: direct; 10:34-36 (يَبْدَؤُا۟، يُعِيدُ، خَلْقَ، يَهْدِىٓ، يُهْدَىٰ، يُتَّبَعَ، ظَنًّا).
- Surprising reach: The argument tests guidance as a capability with prerequisites, much like testing whether a source can initiate the process it claims to direct.

#### Subchannel A. Initiation Before Repetition
- Reading type: surface-primary
- Scene or process: Competing partners are asked whether they can originate creation and then restore it.
- Active motifs: beginning joined to recurrence (quranic:root_000090:B002/m01); creation by origination (quranic:root_000434:B002/m01); return after departure (quranic:root_001058:B001/m01); religious association (quranic:root_000791:B002/m01); truth fixed in reality (quranic:root_000347:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:34 (يَبْدَؤُا۟، خَلْقَ، يُعِيدُ، شُرَكَآئِ); 10:35 (حَقِّ).
- Synthesis: Origination and repetition establish the causal threshold for authority. A claimant that cannot start or restore the process cannot occupy the source position from which direction would proceed.

#### Subchannel B. The Guide Who Must First Be Guided
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: A self-directing guide is contrasted with one that can move only after receiving guidance, while conjecture attempts to substitute for truth.
- Active motifs: gentle direction to a path (quranic:root_001583:B001/m01); a leading guide (quranic:root_001583:B003/m01); following behind (quranic:root_000175:B001/m01); judicial discrimination (quranic:root_000348:B002/m01); conjectural uncertainty (quranic:root_000969:B003/m01); reality-conforming truth (quranic:root_000347:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:35 (يَهْدِىٓ، يَهْدِى، يُهْدَىٰ، يُتَّبَعَ، تَحْكُمُ، حَقِّ); 10:36 (ظَنًّا، حَقِّ).
- Synthesis: Guidance is tested through role reversal. One party leads from itself; the other occupies the dependent position of a follower awaiting direction. Conjecture fails because it cannot repair that causal inversion.

### 10. P3 - Perception Blocked at Its Own Gate
- Semantic invariant: A signal can reach a person while the receiving aperture remains closed to cognition.
- Surface relation: direct; 10:42-43 (يَسْتَمِعُ، تُسْمِعُ، صُّمَّ، يَعْقِلُ، يَنظُرُ، يُبْصِرُ، عُمْىَ).
- Surprising reach: Deafness is a sealed opening and blindness can occupy the heart, turning failed interpretation into a material obstruction.

#### Subchannel A. Sound Without an Opening
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Listening occurs at the surface, but the organ, its opening, and the sound's impact are all interrupted before reason can receive it.
- Active motifs: auditory perception (quranic:root_000741:B001/m01); organ of hearing (quranic:root_000741:B002/m01); loss of hearing (quranic:root_000884:B001/m01); a stopped aperture (quranic:root_000884:B002/m01); sound without impact (quranic:root_000884:B006/m01); reason that restrains ignorance (quranic:root_001036:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:42 (يَسْتَمِعُ، تُسْمِعُ، صُّمَّ، يَعْقِلُ).
- Synthesis: The scene distinguishes acoustic contact from reception. Sound approaches an ear, but the opening is stopped and its impact disappears, so reason never receives material with which to work.

#### Subchannel B. Looking Without Recognition
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Sight is directed toward an object, yet bodily and inward blindness prevent the look from becoming guidance.
- Active motifs: directed looking (quranic:root_001520:B001/m01); eyesight (quranic:root_000121:B001/m01); loss of bodily sight (quranic:root_001049:B001/m01); blindness of inward perception (quranic:root_001049:B002/m01); gentle direction to a path (quranic:root_001583:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:43 (يَنظُرُ، يُبْصِرُ، عُمْىَ، تَهْدِى).
- Synthesis: Looking and seeing are separated as operations. The eye may be aimed, but recognition still fails when blindness occupies either the organ or the inward faculty, leaving guidance unable to complete the visual process.

### 11. P3 - Account Fixes Relation and Time
- Semantic invariant: Final accounting assigns each deed and party its proper relation while preventing the appointed encounter from being transferred, escaped, advanced, or delayed.
- Surface relation: direct; 10:41 (بَرِىٓءٌ، عَمَلِ), 10:45-49 (يَحْشُرُ، يَتَعَارَفُ، رَّسُولٌ، قُضِىَ، قِسْطِ، أَجَلٌ، يَسْتَـْٔخِرُ), 10:53-55 (ٱفْتَدَتْ).
- Surprising reach: Judgment appears as a set of boundary operations: discharge, recognition, fixed scheduling, and failed transfer of liability.

#### Subchannel A. Mutual Discharge from Deeds
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Speaker and deniers separate their liabilities so that neither party can carry the other's work.
- Active motifs: innocence by separation (quranic:root_000100:B002/m01); discharge of a claim (quranic:root_000100:B004/m01); intentional deed (quranic:root_001046:B001/m01); false denial (quranic:root_001290:B001/m01); articulated statement (quranic:root_001272:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:41 (قُل، كَذَّبُ، عَمَلِ، أَعْمَلُ، تَعْمَلُ، بَرِىٓءٌ، بَرِيٓـُٔونَ).
- Synthesis: The response creates a legal and moral boundary around action. Each side is discharged from the other's production, so denial cannot shift the messenger's deed and proclamation cannot absorb the deniers' work.

#### Subchannel B. Compressed Assembly and Recognition
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: A dispersed population is gathered after a stay that feels brief, then recognizes itself through mutual encounter.
- Active motifs: driving a group to one destination (quranic:root_000324:B001/m01); remaining in a place (quranic:root_001339:B001/m01); encounter of two parties (quranic:root_001372:B004/m01); recognition by trace (quranic:root_001002:B003/m01); general loss (quranic:root_000409:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:45 (يَحْشُرُ، يَلْبَثُ، يَتَعَارَفُ، لِقَآءِ، خَسِرَ).
- Synthesis: Gathering compresses elapsed life into something like a short interval, yet recognition survives that compression. The encounter restores relational identity at the moment loss becomes undeniable.

#### Subchannel C. Messenger-Mediated Adjudication
- Reading type: surface-primary
- Scene or process: A messenger arrives within each community, after which a witnessed case is decided with equity.
- Active motifs: messenger and commission (quranic:root_000563:B002/m01); decisive judgment (quranic:root_001237:B001/m01); equity (quranic:root_001224:B001/m01); witnessed presence (quranic:root_000822:B001/m01); separation between parties (quranic:root_000170:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:46 (شَهِيدٌ); 10:47 (رَّسُولٌ، رَسُولُ، قُضِىَ، قِسْطِ، بَيْنَ).
- Synthesis: The messenger is not merely an announcer but the event after which the case becomes ripe for decision. Witness, separation, and equity convert communal history into an adjudicable relation.

#### Subchannel D. The Term That Cannot Move
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: A promised term arrives at a limit that no community can push backward or pull forward, and no self can privately own harm or benefit against it.
- Active motifs: promised horizon (quranic:root_001662:B001/m01); fixed temporal limit (quranic:root_000016:B001/m01); postponement (quranic:root_000019:B002/m01); forward advance (quranic:root_001207:B004/m01); possession and disposal (quranic:root_001444:B002/m01); harm and deficiency (quranic:root_000907:B001/m01); benefit against harm (quranic:root_001536:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:48 (وَعْدُ); 10:49 (أَمْلِكُ، ضَرًّا، نَفْعًا، أَجَلٌ، يَسْتَـْٔخِرُ، يَسْتَقْدِمُ).
- Synthesis: The term behaves like an immovable boundary. Neither private possession nor temporal maneuver can alter it; harm, benefit, delay, and advance all fail as means of rescheduling the encounter.

#### Subchannel E. Liability That Cannot Be Ransomed
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Once truth is fixed, the liable self cannot outrun the claim or transfer it into a ransom, and concealed remorse remains under equitable decision.
- Active motifs: fixed truth (quranic:root_000347:B001/m01); failure to escape pursuit (quranic:root_000985:B002/m01); substitution by ransom (quranic:root_001136:B001/m01); hidden inward state (quranic:root_000697:B001/m01); remorse over what is gone (quranic:root_001485:B001/m01); decisive judgment (quranic:root_001237:B001/m01); equity (quranic:root_001224:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:53 (حَقٌّ، مُعْجِزِينَ); 10:54 (ٱفْتَدَتْ، أَسَرُّ، نَّدَامَةَ، قُضِىَ، قِسْطِ); 10:55 (حَقٌّ).
- Synthesis: Ransom proposes an exchange of bearer, but the fixed claim remains attached to the self. Escape fails spatially, substitution fails transactionally, and hidden remorse cannot interrupt the equitable decision.

### 12. P3 - Moral Force Enters the Body
- Semantic invariant: Discourse and consequence become bodily experiences that alter taste, chest, and breath.
- Surface relation: direct; 10:50-52 (عَذَابُ، ذُوقُ), 10:57-58 (شِفَآءٌ، صُّدُورِ، مَّوْعِظَةٌ، رَحْمَةٌ، يَفْرَحُ).
- Surprising reach: Punishment and admonition are opposing medicines: one is ingested as bitterness, the other opens and treats the chest.

#### Subchannel A. Punishment Tasted
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: An awaited consequence falls into actuality and is experienced as something tasted, with acquired action supplying its recompense.
- Active motifs: falling into fixed occurrence (quranic:root_001675:B001/m01); tasting food (quranic:root_000526:B001/m01); punitive pain (quranic:root_000994:B005/m01); deed met by recompense (quranic:root_000244:B001/m01); acquisition (quranic:root_001296:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:51 (وَقَعَ); 10:52 (ذُوقُ، عَذَابَ، تُجْزَ، تَكْسِبُ).
- Synthesis: The movement from threatened future to present occurrence culminates in ingestion. What was acquired through action returns as a tasted counterpart, placing consequence inside the body rather than merely around it.

#### Subchannel B. Admonition Treats the Chest
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: A warning that softens the heart enters the chest as treatment, guidance, mercy, and released joy.
- Active motifs: heart-softening admonition (quranic:root_001663:B001/m01); healing (quranic:root_000806:B001/m01); bodily chest (quranic:root_000849:B001/m01); gentle direction to a path (quranic:root_001583:B001/m01); mercy (quranic:root_000552:B001/m01); gracious gift (quranic:root_001163:B003/m01); inward joy (quranic:root_001140:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:57 (مَّوْعِظَةٌ، شِفَآءٌ، صُّدُورِ، هُدًى، رَحْمَةٌ); 10:58 (فَضْلِ، رَحْمَتِ، يَفْرَحُ).
- Synthesis: Admonition is a therapeutic entry into the chest. It softens, heals, directs, and expands, so joy is not an unrelated emotion but the bodily release produced by received mercy.

### 13. P4 - Nothing Escapes Live Registration
- Semantic invariant: Every activity is witnessed as it unfolds and entered into a record whose scale reaches below ordinary perception.
- Surface relation: direct; 10:61 (شَأْنٍ، تَتْلُوا۟، تُفِيضُ، شُهُودًا، مِّثْقَالِ، ذَرَّةٍ، أَصْغَرَ، أَكْبَرَ، كِتَٰبٍ، مُّبِينٍ).
- Surprising reach: Witnessing is both continuous presence and microscopic measurement, joining live observation to written granularity.

#### Subchannel A. Activity Under Witness
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Recitation and every intentional undertaking enter a flowing state of activity while witnesses are already present and nothing can become absent.
- Active motifs: affair or circumstance (quranic:root_000773:B001/m01); serial recitation (quranic:root_000186:B001/m01); intentional deed (quranic:root_001046:B001/m01); flowing abundance (quranic:root_001192:B001/m01); witnessed presence (quranic:root_000822:B001/m01); distance and disappearance (quranic:root_001006:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:61 (شَأْنٍ، تَتْلُوا۟، عَمَلٍ، تُفِيضُ، شُهُودًا، يَعْزُبُ).
- Synthesis: Activity is registered in motion, not reconstructed afterward. As attention pours into an affair, witness is already co-present; absence itself becomes the failed operation named by what cannot escape.

#### Subchannel B. The Scaled Record
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: A record resolves events by weight, particulate smallness, comparative scale, and visible written form.
- Active motifs: measured weight (quranic:root_000202:B004/m01); minute scattered particle (quranic:root_000511:B001/m01); smallness (quranic:root_000865:B001/m01); magnitude (quranic:root_001281:B001/m01); written text (quranic:root_001283:B002/m01); visible disclosure (quranic:root_000170:B004/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:61 (مِّثْقَالِ، ذَرَّةٍ، أَصْغَرَ، أَكْبَرَ، كِتَٰبٍ، مُّبِينٍ).
- Synthesis: The record is imagined as an instrument with adjustable resolution. It can weigh, isolate the particle, compare smaller and larger, and expose the result in writing; no event is too fine for inscription.

### 14. P4 - Claims Severed from Warrant
- Semantic invariant: A claim fails when following, attribution, and invention cannot be joined to knowledge or compelling authority.
- Surface relation: direct; 10:66 (يَتَّبِعُ، ظَّنَّ، يَخْرُصُ), 10:68-69 (وَلَدًا، سُلْطَٰنٍۭ، تَعْلَمُ، تَقُولُ، يَفْتَرُ، كَذِبَ).
- Surprising reach: Unsupported theology is exposed as defective fabrication: a guessed relation is assembled without the joint that would attach it to evidence.

#### Subchannel A. Conjectural Following
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Followers orient themselves toward claimed partners through supposition and estimation that shade into speech without knowledge.
- Active motifs: following behind (quranic:root_000175:B001/m01); a claimed entitlement (quranic:root_000478:B002/m01); other-than (quranic:root_000502:B003/m01); religious association (quranic:root_000791:B002/m01); conjectural uncertainty (quranic:root_000969:B003/m01); estimation by guess (quranic:root_000403:B001/m01); speech without knowledge (quranic:root_000403:B002/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:66 (يَتَّبِعُ، يَدْعُ، دُونِ، شُرَكَآءَ، ظَّنَّ، يَخْرُصُ).
- Synthesis: The sequence runs from following to claim to conjecture. Estimation supplies a verbal product but no evidentiary attachment, so the social act of following amplifies a relation that was never established.

#### Subchannel B. Filial Attribution Without Authority
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: A derived offspring is attributed to one who is self-sufficient, while proximity, proof, knowledge, and truthful statement all fail to support the attribution.
- Active motifs: offspring (quranic:root_001683:B001/m01); something derived from a source (quranic:root_001683:B005/m01); self-sufficiency (quranic:root_001110:B001/m01); nearness and presence (quranic:root_001052:B004/m01); compelling proof (quranic:root_000732:B002/m01); disclosed knowledge (quranic:root_001040:B001/m01); attributing what was not so (quranic:root_001272:B005/m01); fabricated falsehood (quranic:root_001150:B003/m01); success and endurance (quranic:root_001175:B005/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:68 (وَلَدًا، غَنِىُّ، عِندَ، سُلْطَٰنٍۭ، تَعْلَمُ، تَقُولُ); 10:69 (يَفْتَرُ، كَذِبَ، يُفْلِحُ).
- Synthesis: The filial claim proposes derivation, yet derivation contradicts self-sufficiency and lacks both proximate evidence and compelling proof. It remains a manufactured attribution whose failure to endure is built into its unsupported construction.

### 15. P5 - Water Sorts Survival from Engulfment
- Semantic invariant: Passage through water separates a rescued remainder from a force that is enclosed, drowned, or left behind.
- Surface relation: direct; 10:73 (فُلْكِ، نَجَّيْ، أَغْرَقْ، خَلَٰٓئِفَ), 10:90-92 (بَحْرَ، جَٰوَزْ، أَدْرَكَ، غَرَقُ، بَدَنِ، نُنَجِّي).
- Surprising reach: Rescue is a physical extraction that can preserve either a living community for succession or a dead body for visibility.

#### Subchannel A. The Vessel Transfers Succession
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Denial is answered by rescue in a vessel, drowning of the rejecting group, and installation of the rescued as successors whose outcome becomes a sign.
- Active motifs: false denial (quranic:root_001290:B001/m01); escape by separation (quranic:root_001476:B001/m01); ship moving in water (quranic:root_001177:B003/m01); drowning as killing (quranic:root_001080:B002/m01); making a thing enter a state (quranic:root_000248:B002/m01); successor replacing another (quranic:root_000433:B001/m01); final outcome (quranic:root_001033:B006/m01); warning that awakens caution (quranic:root_001488:B001/m01); visible sign (quranic:root_000074:B003/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:73 (كَذَّبُ، نَجَّيْ، فُلْكِ، أَغْرَقْ، جَعَلْ، خَلَٰٓئِفَ، عَٰقِبَةُ، مُنذَرِينَ، ـَٔايَٰتِ).
- Synthesis: The vessel does more than remove occupants from danger. It transfers historical position: one group is submerged, another is made successor, and the completed sorting becomes a visible warning.

#### Subchannel B. Crossing Ends in Bodily Extraction
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: A people cross the sea while an armed pursuer runs behind, overtakes the passage, drowns, and is extracted bodily as a sign.
- Active motifs: traversing a place (quranic:root_000276:B002/m01); wide sea (quranic:root_000086:B001/m01); running pursuit (quranic:root_000993:B002/m01); mutually supporting army (quranic:root_000264:B001/m01); overtaking and reaching (quranic:root_000471:B001/m01); drowning in water (quranic:root_001080:B001/m01); surrendering the self (quranic:root_000737:B012/m01); belief that settles the heart (quranic:root_000054:B002/m01); scraping out and extracting (quranic:root_001476:B003/m01); bodily person (quranic:root_000096:B001/m01); position behind (quranic:root_000433:B002/m01); visible sign (quranic:root_000074:B003/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:90 (جَٰوَزْ، بَحْرَ، أَتْبَعَ، عَدْوًا، جُنُودُ، أَدْرَكَ، غَرَقُ، مُسْلِمِينَ، ءَامَن); 10:92 (نُنَجِّي، بَدَنِ، خَلْفَ، ءَايَةً).
- Synthesis: The crossing reverses the geometry of pursuit. The force behind catches up only to be enclosed by the medium already traversed by the rescued; extraction then preserves the body, not the regime, as a sign for those behind.

### 16. P5 - Coercive Power Meets Counter-Trust
- Semantic invariant: A regime attempts to control belief through social elevation, fear, and trial, while a vulnerable group relocates agency through entrustment.
- Surface relation: direct; 10:83-86 (مَلَإِي۟، عَالٍ، يَفْتِنَ، خَوْفٍ، تَوَكَّلُ، مُّسْلِمِينَ، فِتْنَةً، نَجِّ).
- Surprising reach: Entrustment is a transfer of custody that counters political mastery without imitating its coercive operation.

#### Subchannel A. Elite Power as Assay and Deflection
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: An aligned elite sustains elevation and mastery through fear, testing, deflection, and affliction directed at a small believing remainder.
- Active motifs: minute dispersed offspring (quranic:root_000511:B001/m01); elite assembly (quranic:root_001441:B002/m01); exalted domination (quranic:root_001042:B003/m01); mastery and seizure (quranic:root_001042:B004/m01); testing by assay (quranic:root_001128:B001/m01); deflection from truth (quranic:root_001128:B003/m01); afflictive trial (quranic:root_001128:B004/m01); fear of anticipated harm (quranic:root_000447:B001/m01); exceeding the limit (quranic:root_000699:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:83 (ذُرِّيَّةٌ، مَلَإِي۟، عَالٍ، يَفْتِنَ، خَوْفٍ، مُسْرِفِينَ).
- Synthesis: Coercion is shown as a metallurgical and directional process. Power tests the small remainder, tries to bend it away from truth, and converts political superiority into a continuous environment of affliction.

#### Subchannel B. Entrusting Under Threat
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Belief and surrender lead the threatened community to transfer its affair into another's custody, refuse becoming material for oppression, and seek extraction.
- Active motifs: belief that settles the heart (quranic:root_000054:B002/m01); safety and surrender (quranic:root_000737:B001/m01); handing over an affair (quranic:root_001681:B001/m01); reliance through entrustment (quranic:root_001681:B002/m01); afflictive trial (quranic:root_001128:B004/m01); mercy (quranic:root_000552:B001/m01); escape by separation (quranic:root_001476:B001/m01); concealment of truth (quranic:root_001307:B003/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:84 (ءَامَن، مُّسْلِمِينَ، تَوَكَّلُ); 10:85 (تَوَكَّلْ، فِتْنَةً); 10:86 (رَحْمَتِ، نَجِّ، كَٰفِرِينَ).
- Synthesis: Trust does not deny vulnerability; it changes who holds the affair. The community's surrender removes ultimate custody from the coercive regime and turns rescue into separation from both trial and the truth-concealing order that administers it.

### 17. P5 - The Contest of Appearances
- Semantic invariant: A staged display is tested by whether it can remain stable when truth acts upon it.
- Surface relation: direct; 10:76-82 (حَقُّ، سِحْرٌ، سَٰحِرٍ، أَلْقُ، يُبْطِلُ، مُفْسِدِينَ، يُصْلِحُ، يُحِقُّ).
- Surprising reach: Truth does not merely contradict magic verbally; it removes the display's stability and restores a damaged order.

#### Subchannel A. Staged Casting and Deceptive Skill
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: A truth claim is redescribed as magic, expert performers are assembled, and a display is thrown into the shared field under a test of success.
- Active motifs: reality-conforming truth (quranic:root_000347:B001/m01); deceptive diversion (quranic:root_000682:B002/m01); disclosed expertise (quranic:root_001040:B001/m01); casting an object down (quranic:root_001372:B005/m01); success and endurance (quranic:root_001175:B005/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:76-77 (حَقُّ، حَقِّ، سِحْرٌ، سَّٰحِرُونَ، يُفْلِحُ); 10:79-80 (سَٰحِرٍ، عَلِيمٍ، أَلْقُ).
- Synthesis: The display depends on skilled redescription and controlled casting. Its claim to success rests on maintaining the diversion after it enters the public field, which makes stability rather than spectacle the decisive test.

#### Subchannel B. Nullification and Repair
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: The cast display loses its claim to reality, is actively removed, and the corrupted field is repaired by establishing truth.
- Active motifs: loss of truth and stability (quranic:root_000127:B001/m01); active nullification (quranic:root_000127:B002/m01); corruption from proper order (quranic:root_001154:B001/m01); restoration against corruption (quranic:root_000876:B001/m01); establishing and manifesting truth (quranic:root_000347:B005/m01); meaningful word (quranic:root_001316:B002/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:81 (يُبْطِلُ، مُفْسِدِينَ، يُصْلِحُ); 10:82 (يُحِقُّ، حَقَّ، كَلِمَٰتِ).
- Synthesis: Nullification is not simple disappearance. The false display is deprived of stability, removed, and followed by repair; truth acts as the operation that returns the scene from corruption to ordered endurance.

### 18. P5 - Material Power Dismantled
- Semantic invariant: Wealth and ornament acquire social force by directing hearts and paths, then lose that force when their traces and receiving organs are disabled.
- Surface relation: direct; 10:88 (ءَاتَيْ، مَلَأَ، زِينَةً، أَمْوَٰلًا، سَبِيلِ، يُضِلُّ، ٱطْمِسْ، ٱشْدُدْ، قُلُوبِ، يَرَ).
- Surprising reach: The prayer targets wealth as an infrastructure of perception: erase its traces and bind the heart that converts display into direction.

#### Subchannel A. Wealth and Ornament as a Directional Apparatus
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Bestowed wealth and adornment concentrate in an elite and become a means of diverting people from a traversable path.
- Active motifs: giving and bestowal (quranic:root_000009:B002/m01); elite assembly (quranic:root_001441:B002/m01); worn or displayed ornament (quranic:root_000660:B003/m01); accumulated wealth (quranic:root_001457:B001/m01); worldly benefit (quranic:root_000383:B013/m01); extended path (quranic:root_000672:B001/m01); deviation from direction (quranic:root_000913:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:88 (ءَاتَيْ، مَلَأَ، زِينَةً، أَمْوَٰلًا، حَيَوٰةِ، سَبِيلِ، يُضِلُّ).
- Synthesis: Wealth is not passive inventory. In elite hands its ornament becomes a visible directional device, converting bestowed goods into a route that draws others away from the intended path.

#### Subchannel B. Erasing the Trace and Binding the Receiver
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: The apparatus is disabled by wiping its marks, extinguishing its visual force, tightening the heart, and withholding sight until painful consequence arrives.
- Active motifs: erasure of a trace (quranic:root_000950:B001/m01); extinction of light or sight (quranic:root_000950:B002/m01); tightening a bond (quranic:root_000782:B001/m01); heart as receiving organ (quranic:root_001248:B001/m01); visual perception (quranic:root_000531:B001/m01); punitive pain (quranic:root_000994:B005/m01); felt pain (quranic:root_000046:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:88 (ٱطْمِسْ، ٱشْدُدْ، قُلُوبِ، يَرَ، عَذَابَ، أَلِيمَ).
- Synthesis: The counter-operation addresses both signal and receiver. Erasure removes the display's trace, extinguishing blocks its visual efficacy, and the tightened heart can no longer turn ornament into guidance.

### 19. P6 - Belief Enters Through Thresholds
- Semantic invariant: Belief cannot be manufactured at will; it meets fixed word, volition, permission, and cognition as distinct thresholds.
- Surface relation: direct; 10:96-100 (كَلِمَتُ، حَقَّتْ، يُؤْمِنُ، ءَايَةٍ، شَآءَ، تُكْرِهُ، إِذْنِ، رِّجْسَ، يَعْقِلُ).
- Surprising reach: Permission resembles an admission gate, while cognitive refusal becomes a contaminating material placed on the person.

#### Subchannel A. Fixed Word and Exhausted Sign
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: A binding word fixes a condition under which repeated visible signs do not become settled belief before painful punishment is seen.
- Active motifs: meaningful word (quranic:root_001316:B002/m01); binding fixed obligation (quranic:root_000347:B002/m01); belief that settles the heart (quranic:root_000054:B002/m01); visible sign (quranic:root_000074:B003/m01); visual perception (quranic:root_000531:B001/m01); punitive pain (quranic:root_000994:B005/m01); felt pain (quranic:root_000046:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:96 (كَلِمَتُ، حَقَّتْ، يُؤْمِنُ); 10:97 (ءَايَةٍ، يَرَ، عَذَابَ، أَلِيمَ).
- Synthesis: The failure is not a shortage of visible material. Sign follows sign, yet a fixed word governs the threshold at which seeing could become settled belief; by the time punishment is seen, perception has arrived without admission.

#### Subchannel B. Will Without Coercion
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Universal belief is imaginable under encompassing will, but the addressee is denied the role of forcing selves across that boundary.
- Active motifs: will directed toward a thing (quranic:root_000831:B002/m01); forcing another into what is disliked (quranic:root_001295:B003/m01); gathering multiplicity (quranic:root_000259:B001/m01); belief that settles the heart (quranic:root_000054:B002/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:99 (شَآءَ، تُكْرِهُ، جَمِيعًا، كُلُّ، ءَامَنَ، مُؤْمِنِينَ).
- Synthesis: The verse separates the capacity to will a total outcome from the human attempt to compel individual selves. Gathering all believers would be an effect of encompassing will, not a product of interpersonal force.

#### Subchannel C. Permission Versus Contamination
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: A living self crosses into belief only by permission, while refusal of reason leaves a contaminating layer placed upon it.
- Active motifs: authorization (quranic:root_000022:B004/m01); living self (quranic:root_001533:B011/m01); making a thing enter a state (quranic:root_000248:B002/m01); contaminating filth (quranic:root_000543:B001/m01); reason that restrains ignorance (quranic:root_001036:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:100 (إِذْنِ، نَفْسٍ، يَجْعَلُ، رِّجْسَ، يَعْقِلُ).
- Synthesis: Permission opens the threshold, whereas abandoned reason allows contamination to adhere. Belief and filth therefore appear as opposed state changes, not merely opposed propositions.

### 20. P6 - Timed Response and Rescue
- Semantic invariant: Outcomes remain open or closed according to when a community responds within a sequence of warning, waiting, and rescue.
- Surface relation: direct; 10:98 (قَرْيَةٌ، ءَامَنَتْ، نَفَعَ، كَشَفْ، حِينٍ), 10:101-103 (ٱنظُرُ، نُّذُرُ، يَنتَظِرُ، نُنَجِّى).
- Surprising reach: Belief has temporal efficacy: the same response that is unavailable at one threshold can still remove a covering when it occurs within an open interval.

#### Subchannel A. The City Whose Belief Became Useful
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: A gathered settlement believes while the interval remains open, so belief becomes beneficial, a degrading punishment is uncovered, and enjoyment continues to a term.
- Active motifs: gathered village (quranic:root_001222:B001/m01); belief that settles the heart (quranic:root_000054:B002/m01); benefit against harm (quranic:root_001536:B001/m01); removal of a covering (quranic:root_001302:B001/m01); disgrace and exclusion (quranic:root_000407:B001/m01); punitive pain (quranic:root_000994:B005/m01); appointed time (quranic:root_000382:B001/m01); prolonged enjoyment (quranic:root_001395:B007/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:98 (قَرْيَةٌ، ءَامَنَتْ، إِيمَٰنُ، نَفَعَ، كَشَفْ، خِزْىِ، عَذَابَ، حِينٍ، مَتَّعْ).
- Synthesis: The city's response arrives before closure. Belief performs an observable operation: it benefits the settlement by removing the layer of disgrace and reopening time for continued life.

#### Subchannel B. Looking and Waiting Through Precedents
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: The observer is directed toward signs and warnings, then asked to wait within a temporal pattern already exemplified by vanished generations.
- Active motifs: directed inspection (quranic:root_001520:B001/m01); visible sign (quranic:root_000074:B003/m01); warning that awakens caution (quranic:root_001488:B001/m01); self-sufficiency (quranic:root_001110:B001/m01); instructive likeness (quranic:root_001397:B003/m01); elapsed generation (quranic:root_000436:B003/m01); temporal days (quranic:root_001700:B002/m01); waiting and granting time (quranic:root_001520:B002/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:101 (ٱنظُرُ، ءَايَٰتُ، نُّذُرُ، تُغْنِى); 10:102 (مِثْلَ، خَلَ، أَيَّامِ، يَنتَظِرُ، ٱنتَظِرُ، مُنتَظِرِينَ).
- Synthesis: Looking supplies the visible field, while waiting supplies its temporal depth. Past days become an instructive pattern in which present warning will acquire an outcome, so observation is incomplete without duration.

#### Subchannel C. Rescue as a Fixed Rule
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: After the warning sequence matures, messengers and believers are separated out by rescue as an established obligation.
- Active motifs: messenger and commission (quranic:root_000563:B002/m01); belief that settles the heart (quranic:root_000054:B002/m01); escape by separation (quranic:root_001476:B001/m01); binding fixed obligation (quranic:root_000347:B002/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:103 (رُسُلَ، ءَامَنُ، مُؤْمِنِينَ، نُنَجِّى، نُنجِ، حَقًّا).
- Synthesis: Rescue is the sorting operation that closes the warning sequence. Its designation as fixed makes deliverance part of the same ordered timing as the threatened outcome, not an interruption from outside the process.

### 21. P6 - Exclusive Orientation and Causal Dependence
- Semantic invariant: Correct orientation follows the direction from which worship, harm, benefit, and good can actually proceed.
- Surface relation: direct; 10:104-107 (دِينِ، أَعْبُدُ، وَجْهَ، حَنِيفًا، تَدْعُ، يَضُرُّ، يَنفَعُ، يَمْسَسْ، كَاشِفَ، رَآدَّ).
- Surprising reach: Upright worship is tested as causal alignment: the face should point toward the source that can touch, remove, target, or repel an outcome.

#### Subchannel A. Face Fixed to Upright Worship
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: The face is assigned a direction of obedient worship, inclined away from association and held through the boundary of death.
- Active motifs: direction and orientation (quranic:root_001630:B002/m01); inclination toward a side (quranic:root_000362:B002/m01); obedience and submission (quranic:root_000504:B001/m01); worshipful subjection (quranic:root_000973:B003/m01); religious association (quranic:root_000791:B002/m01); taking the self at death (quranic:root_001669:B002/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:104 (دِينِ، أَعْبُدُ، يَتَوَفَّىٰ); 10:105 (أَقِمْ، وَجْهَ، حَنِيفًا، مُشْرِكِينَ).
- Synthesis: Worship is spatialized as a fixed face and deliberate inclination. The orientation is exclusive because it persists across the entire obedient relation, including the final taking of the self.

#### Subchannel B. The Subordinate Call Without Causal Reach
- Reading type: surface-primary
- Scene or process: Calling upon an other-than source is tested against its inability to produce either harm or benefit.
- Active motifs: summons by call (quranic:root_000478:B001/m01); other-than (quranic:root_000502:B003/m01); harm and deficiency (quranic:root_000907:B001/m01); benefit against harm (quranic:root_001536:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:106 (تَدْعُ، دُونِ، يَضُرُّ، يَنفَعُ).
- Synthesis: The call attempts to create a causal link through address. The link fails because the invoked other occupies neither endpoint of the harm-benefit relation, leaving the act of calling without operative reach.

#### Subchannel C. Touch, Removal, and Unrepellable Good
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Harm touches a person and can be uncovered only at its source, while intended good reaches its target and cannot be pushed back.
- Active motifs: contact that leaves an effect (quranic:root_001423:B004/m01); removal of a covering (quranic:root_001302:B001/m01); will and intention (quranic:root_000610:B001/m01); hitting an intended target (quranic:root_000889:B003/m01); repelling and turning away (quranic:root_000555:B002/m01); beneficial good (quranic:root_000452:B001/m01); gracious gift (quranic:root_001163:B003/m01); protective forgiveness (quranic:root_001096:B002/m01); mercy (quranic:root_000552:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:107 (يَمْسَسْ، ضُرٍّ، كَاشِفَ، يُرِدْ، يُصِيبُ، رَآدَّ، خَيْرٍ، فَضْلِ، غَفُورُ، رَّحِيمُ).
- Synthesis: Harm and good move differently but reveal the same source. Harm adheres by touch and requires uncovering; good is deliberately aimed, lands on the recipient, and defeats attempted repulsion. Mercy and forgiveness name the protected state created by that causal control.

### 22. P6 - Truth Fixes Conduct Without Transferring Agency
- Semantic invariant: Once truth arrives, each self bears its own direction while the messenger's task becomes faithful following and patient judgment.
- Surface relation: direct; 10:108-109 (جَآءَ، حَقُّ، ٱهْتَدَىٰ، نَفْسِ، ضَلَّ، وَكِيلٍ، ٱتَّبِعْ، يُوحَىٰٓ، ٱصْبِرْ، يَحْكُمَ).
- Surprising reach: Guidance creates accountability without making the messenger a custodian of another self.

#### Subchannel A. Guidance Returns to the Self
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Arriving truth opens guidance, but both finding and losing the path return to the self, while custodial responsibility is withheld from the messenger.
- Active motifs: arrival and occurrence (quranic:root_000281:B001/m01); reality-conforming truth (quranic:root_000347:B001/m01); gentle direction to a path (quranic:root_001583:B001/m01); deviation from direction (quranic:root_000913:B001/m01); loss of the object (quranic:root_000913:B003/m01); the self as the thing itself (quranic:root_001533:B012/m01); custodian sufficient for an affair (quranic:root_001681:B006/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:108 (جَآءَ، حَقُّ، ٱهْتَدَىٰ، يَهْتَدِى، ضَلَّ، يَضِلُّ، نَفْسِ، وَكِيلٍ).
- Synthesis: Truth arrives publicly, but direction resolves privately. Guidance benefits the self and loss falls upon it; refusing custodial transfer preserves both the messenger's limit and the hearer's agency.

#### Subchannel B. Patient Adherence Under Pending Judgment
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: The messenger follows received communication, restrains the self through delay, and waits for discriminating judgment.
- Active motifs: following behind (quranic:root_000175:B001/m01); divine communication (quranic:root_001633:B004/m01); restraint through patience (quranic:root_000840:B001/m01); judicial discrimination (quranic:root_000348:B002/m01); superior good (quranic:root_000452:B002/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:109 (ٱتَّبِعْ، يُوحَىٰٓ، ٱصْبِرْ، يَحْكُمَ، حَٰكِمِينَ، خَيْرُ).
- Synthesis: Following governs the content of action, while patience governs its timing. Judgment belongs to the discriminating authority, so faithful conduct consists in preserving both received direction and the interval before decision.

## Standalone Subchannels

### S1. P1 - Crisis Postures and Released Pressure
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Harm makes a person call from multiple bodily postures; removal of the affliction releases motion, after which the former crisis is passed by and excess is beautified.
- Active motifs: contact that leaves an effect (quranic:root_001423:B004/m01); harm and deficiency (quranic:root_000907:B001/m01); summons by call (quranic:root_000478:B001/m01); seated stability (quranic:root_001244:B001/m01); bodily standing (quranic:root_001273:B002/m01); bodily side (quranic:root_000262:B001/m01); removal of a covering (quranic:root_001302:B001/m01); passing onward (quranic:root_001414:B001/m01); exceeding the limit (quranic:root_000699:B001/m01); beautifying display (quranic:root_000660:B002/m01).
