- Ayah anchors: 10:12 (مَسَّ، ضُّرُّ، دَعَا، يَدْعُ، قَاعِدًا، قَآئِمًا، جَنۢبِ، كَشَفْ، مَرَّ، مُسْرِفِينَ، زُيِّنَ).
- Synthesis: Affliction reorganizes the body around appeal: lying on the side, sitting, and standing all become calling positions. Once the covering is lifted, motion resumes so completely that the crisis is passed as though it had not fixed the body in place.

### S2. P1 - Erased Generation, Installed Successor
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: A culpable generation is destroyed, another is installed in its place on earth, and the successor's action becomes the object of inspection.
- Active motifs: collapse into destruction (quranic:root_001596:B001/m01); generation joined in one period (quranic:root_001221:B005/m01); successor replacing another (quranic:root_000433:B001/m01); making a thing enter a state (quranic:root_000248:B002/m01); earth below (quranic:root_000025:B001/m01); directed inspection (quranic:root_001520:B001/m01); intentional deed (quranic:root_001046:B001/m01); culpable offense (quranic:root_000239:B004/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:13 (أَهْلَكْ، قُرُونَ، مُجْرِمِينَ); 10:14 (جَعَلْ، خَلَٰٓئِفَ، أَرْضِ، نَنظُرَ، تَعْمَلُ).
- Synthesis: Succession is an installation into a vacated position, not simple chronology. Destruction clears the occupied place, the new group is made to stand there, and observation transfers immediately to what it will produce.

### S3. P1 - Claimed Intermediaries Assembled from Proximity
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Other-than agents are brought near as partners and intercessors, but the constructed relation fails the harm-benefit test.
- Active motifs: intercessor joining another (quranic:root_000802:B002/m01); religious association (quranic:root_000791:B002/m01); nearness below the ultimate point (quranic:root_000502:B001/m01); other-than (quranic:root_000502:B003/m01); nearness and presence (quranic:root_001052:B004/m01); harm and deficiency (quranic:root_000907:B001/m01); benefit against harm (quranic:root_001536:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:18 (شُفَعَٰٓؤُ، يُشْرِكُ، دُونِ، عِندَ، يَقُولُ، يَضُرُّ، يَنفَعُ).
- Synthesis: The intermediary relation is assembled out of proximity: an additional party is joined, placed near, and claimed as a partner. Yet the assembly has no causal completion because neither harm nor benefit passes through it.

### S4. P3 - Provision Enters a Classification Gate
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Descended provision is divided into prohibited and released classes, but the human classification lacks permission and becomes fabrication.
- Active motifs: delivery by descent (quranic:root_001492:B002/m01); apportioned gift (quranic:root_000560:B001/m01); nourishing food (quranic:root_000560:B002/m01); making a thing enter a state (quranic:root_000248:B002/m01); prohibition (quranic:root_000313:B001/m01); release from prohibition (quranic:root_000351:B003/m01); authorization (quranic:root_000022:B004/m01); fabricated falsehood (quranic:root_001150:B003/m01); contradiction of truth (quranic:root_001290:B001/m01); recognition of a gift (quranic:root_000810:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:59 (أَنزَلَ، رِّزْقٍ، جَعَلْ، حَرَامًا، حَلَٰلًا، أَذِنَ، تَفْتَرُ); 10:60 (كَذِبَ، يَشْكُرُ).
- Synthesis: The scene places a gate of classification after the arrival of provision. Without authorization, labeling food forbidden or released does not regulate the gift; it fabricates a new status and blocks recognition of the giver.

### S5. P3 - Life Switched, Return Enforced
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Life is activated, extinguished, and directed back through one controlling movement.
- Active motifs: living being (quranic:root_000383:B003/m01); loss of life (quranic:root_001454:B001/m01); restoration to a prior state (quranic:root_000544:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:56 (يُحْىِۦ، يُمِيتُ، تُرْجَعُ).
- Synthesis: Animation, extinction, and return are three state transitions under one agency. The compact sequence prevents life and death from becoming independent endpoints; each is a controlled switch within the movement back.

### S6. P4 - Protective Proximity Without Fear
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Nearness, loyal support, settled belief, and self-protection form a condition in which fear and grief cannot take hold, while glad news opens toward victory.
- Active motifs: unbroken nearness (quranic:root_001684:B001/m01); loving support (quranic:root_001684:B004/m01); fear of anticipated harm (quranic:root_000447:B001/m01); inward grief (quranic:root_000317:B001/m01); belief that settles the heart (quranic:root_000054:B002/m01); warding off harm (quranic:root_001677:B001/m01); placing the self in protection (quranic:root_001677:B002/m01); glad news that brightens the face (quranic:root_000120:B005/m01); attainment of good (quranic:root_001186:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:62 (أَوْلِيَآءَ، خَوْفٌ، يَحْزَنُ); 10:63 (ءَامَنُ، يَتَّقُ); 10:64 (بُشْرَىٰ، فَوْزُ).
- Synthesis: Protective nearness is a relational enclosure. Belief and vigilance place the self inside it, excluding anticipated fear and retained grief; glad news then appears as the outward change of complexion produced by secure relation.

### S7. P4 - Night Settles, Day Opens Perception
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Night removes motion and makes a dwelling of rest, while day opens into visibility for a community capable of hearing.
- Active motifs: night and its darkness (quranic:root_001392:B001/m01); daylight opening (quranic:root_001559:B002/m01); cessation of movement (quranic:root_000726:B001/m01); inhabited rest (quranic:root_000726:B002/m01); auditory perception (quranic:root_000741:B001/m01); eyesight (quranic:root_000121:B001/m01); visible sign (quranic:root_000074:B003/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:67 (يْلَ، نَّهَارَ، تَسْكُنُ، يَسْمَعُ، مُبْصِرًا، ءَايَٰتٍ).
- Synthesis: Night and day are complementary perceptual states. Night settles movement into habitable rest; day opens the field to sight, while hearing marks the inward reception needed to read both changes as signs.

### S8. P4 - Temporary Benefit Returns as Experienced Severity
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Worldly benefit is extended for use, then the recipient returns and undergoes severe punishment as direct experience.
- Active motifs: usable benefit (quranic:root_001395:B001/m01); extended enjoyment (quranic:root_001395:B007/m01); the lower world (quranic:root_000493:B002/m01); experience by tasting (quranic:root_000526:B002/m01); forceful severity (quranic:root_000782:B002/m01); punitive pain (quranic:root_000994:B005/m01); concealment of truth (quranic:root_001307:B003/m01); restoration to a prior point (quranic:root_000544:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:70 (مَتَٰعٌ، دُّنْيَا، نُذِيقُ، شَّدِيدَ، عَذَابَ، يَكْفُرُ، مَرْجِعُ).
- Synthesis: Temporary use and final experience form one return circuit. The lower-world benefit is real but time-bound; after return, tasting converts the concealed truth of its limit into an embodied severity.

### S9. P5 - Noah's Unclouded Resolution
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: A burdensome public stand is met by trust, consolidated resolve, assembled opposition, removal of obscurity, decisive execution, and refusal of respite.
- Active motifs: confrontation (quranic:root_001273:B014/m01); burdensome heaviness (quranic:root_001281:B010/m01); reminder that recalls (quranic:root_000516:B009/m01); reliance through entrustment (quranic:root_001681:B002/m01); resolve gathered after dispersion (quranic:root_000259:B003/m01); collusive assembly (quranic:root_000259:B013/m01); covering and enclosure (quranic:root_001108:B001/m01); obscured affair (quranic:root_001108:B003/m01); decisive execution (quranic:root_001237:B005/m01); waiting and granting time (quranic:root_001520:B002/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:71 (مَّقَامِ، كَبُرَ، تَذْكِيرِ، تَوَكَّلْ، أَجْمِعُ، شُرَكَآءَ، غُمَّةً، ٱقْضُ، تُنظِرُ).
- Synthesis: The warning becomes a deliberately clarified confrontation. Trust consolidates Noah's side; the opponents are told to consolidate theirs, strip obscurity from the affair, execute their decision, and omit delay. The scene tests which resolution can remain coherent in full exposure.

### S10. P5 - Warning Without Hired Dependence
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: A warning continues despite refusal because no requested wage binds the speaker to the audience; compensation and command come from elsewhere.
- Active motifs: turning away (quranic:root_001684:B007/m01); request (quranic:root_000661:B001/m01); compensation for work (quranic:root_000015:B001/m01); binding command (quranic:root_000051:B002/m01); surrendering an affair (quranic:root_000737:B012/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:72 (تَوَلَّيْ، سَأَلْ، أَجْرٍ، أَجْرِ، أُمِرْ، مُسْلِمِينَ).
- Synthesis: Refusal cannot terminate the speech because the audience is not its employer. The absence of requested compensation breaks economic dependence, while command and surrender relocate obligation beyond the hearers.

### S11. P5 - Built Orientation Under Pressure
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Revelation directs two brothers to establish dwellings in a city, convert houses into oriented places, maintain prayer, and announce good news to the believing community.
- Active motifs: divine communication (quranic:root_001633:B004/m01); brotherhood (quranic:root_000020:B001/m01); taking a dwelling (quranic:root_000162:B001/m01); sheltering house (quranic:root_000166:B001/m01); settled city (quranic:root_001428:B003/m01); making a thing enter a state (quranic:root_000248:B002/m01); prayerward direction (quranic:root_001198:B005/m01); prescribed worship (quranic:root_000879:B003/m01); community (quranic:root_001273:B001/m01); glad news that brightens the face (quranic:root_000120:B005/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:87 (أَوْحَيْ، أَخِي، تَبَوَّءَ، بُيُوتًا، مِصْرَ، ٱجْعَلُ، قِبْلَةً، صَّلَوٰةَ، قَوْمِ، بَشِّرِ).
- Synthesis: The response to pressure is architectural and liturgical. Domestic shelters are deliberately reoriented into a distributed sacred infrastructure, allowing the community to hold prayer and hope inside the contested city.

### S12. P5 - Answered Appeal Straightens Conduct
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: A spoken appeal receives a verbal answer, after which the callers must hold a straight course and refuse the path of those without knowledge.
- Active motifs: summons by call (quranic:root_000478:B001/m01); verbal response (quranic:root_000273:B003/m01); straightness and balance (quranic:root_001273:B008/m01); extended path (quranic:root_000672:B001/m01); following behind (quranic:root_000175:B001/m01); disclosed knowledge (quranic:root_001040:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:89 (دَّعْوَتُ، أُجِيبَت، ٱسْتَقِيمَ، سَبِيلَ، تَتَّبِعَآ، يَعْلَمُ).
- Synthesis: Answer does not close the appeal into passive assurance. It creates a new behavioral line: the recipients must straighten themselves, remain on a traversable route, and decline guidance from unknowing followers.

### S13. P6 - Settled Provision, Knowledge, Then Division
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: A lineage is given stable lodging and wholesome food; only after knowledge arrives do its members take divergent paths requiring later judgment.
- Active motifs: attributed lineage (quranic:root_000156:B007/m01); taking a settled lodging (quranic:root_000162:B001/m01); complete and sound settlement (quranic:root_000852:B003/m01); nourishing food (quranic:root_000560:B002/m01); wholesome purity (quranic:root_000961:B001/m01); each taking a different path (quranic:root_000433:B004/m01); disclosed knowledge (quranic:root_001040:B001/m01); decisive judgment (quranic:root_001237:B001/m01); separation between parties (quranic:root_000170:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:93 (بَنِىٓ، بَوَّأْ، مُبَوَّأَ، صِدْقٍ، رَزَقْ، طَّيِّبَٰتِ، ٱخْتَلَفُ، عِلْمُ، يَقْضِى، بَيْنَ).
- Synthesis: Material settlement precedes epistemic fracture. Lodging and food establish a sound common base, but knowledge does not preserve unity automatically; divergence begins after disclosure and turns the final decision into a separation of paths.

### S14. P6 - Reader-to-Reader Authentication
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: A reader troubled by doubt is directed to earlier readers of written material, while denial, fabrication, and loss define the failure of that authentication relation.
- Active motifs: destabilizing doubt (quranic:root_000812:B001/m01); request for an answer (quranic:root_000661:B001/m01); reading and recitation (quranic:root_001210:B002/m01); written text (quranic:root_001283:B002/m01); precedence (quranic:root_001198:B002/m01); delivery by descent (quranic:root_001492:B002/m01); wavering doubt (quranic:root_001416:B004/m01); denial through disputation (quranic:root_001416:B005/m01); false denial (quranic:root_001290:B001/m01); visible sign (quranic:root_000074:B003/m01); general loss (quranic:root_000409:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:94 (شَكٍّ، سْـَٔلِ، يَقْرَءُ، كِتَٰبَ، قَبْلِ، أَنزَلْ، مُمْتَرِينَ); 10:95 (كَذَّبُ، ـَٔايَٰتِ، خَٰسِرِينَ).
- Synthesis: Authentication is social but text-bound: one reader tests received material against a prior reading community. Doubt becomes denial only when that relation is refused and visible signs are treated as false, converting uncertainty into loss.

### S15. Whole-Surah - Tailoring and Dyeing a Deceptive Appearance
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: Cloth is cut and fitted with a perforating tool, saturated with color, turned into a dyed surface that misrepresents its condition, and wrapped around a wearer.
- Active motifs: cutting, fitting, and sewing a garment (quranic:root_001240:B012/m01); cobbler's awl and perforator (quranic:root_000806:B003/m01); color soaking into material (quranic:root_000783:B007/m01); dyed cloth that lies by its appearance (quranic:root_001290:B009/m01); blotchy or unstable dye in cloth (quranic:root_001428:B005/m01); wrapping oneself in a garment (quranic:root_001163:B005/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:27 (قِطَعًا); 10:57 (شِفَآءٌ); 10:4 (شَرَابٌ); 10:17 (كَذِبًا); 10:87 (مِصْرَ); 10:58 (فَضْلِ).
- Synthesis: The motifs form a complete appearance-making craft: measure and cut, pierce and join, saturate with color, then wear the result. Because the falsehood branch itself names a cloth whose colored surface “lies,” this scene materially reframes the surah's fabrication and counterfeit-discourse reading: a false appearance can be deliberately made, fitted, and inhabited even when its dye remains unstable.

### S16. Whole-Surah - The Concealed Hunter and the Snare
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: A hunter goes out, hides behind cover or in a blind, carries a bow-linked quiver, sets a snare, and inspects whether the struck game has died.
- Active motifs: going out to hunt (quranic:root_000745:B006/m01); concealment behind a mount for a shot (quranic:root_000473:B003/m01); hunter's blind or pit (quranic:root_001199:B002/m01); hunter's entangling snare (quranic:root_000791:B006/m01); quiver joined to bow and weapons (quranic:root_001221:B007/m01); determining whether struck game is dead (quranic:root_001454:B014/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:31 (سَّمَآءِ، مَيِّتِ); 10:16 (أَدْرَىٰ); 10:26 (قَتَرٌ); 10:18 (يُشْرِكُ); 10:13 (قُرُونَ).
- Synthesis: Cover, blind, weapon, trap, and inspection make one ordered hunt rather than an animal inventory. The scene usefully pressures the surah's primary critique of claimed partners because the latent branch of association is literally the hunter's snare: false partnership becomes an apparatus of entanglement operated from concealment, sharpening the demand to inspect rather than follow conjecture.

### S17. Whole-Surah - Casting Marked Lots for Winner and Loser
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: Marked gaming arrows are gathered in a container, one named share enters the set, the lots are cast from the hand, and winning and losing arrows distribute the result through wager and deception.
- Active motifs: container holding gaming arrows (quranic:root_000532:B010/m01); identifying mark placed on an object (quranic:root_001040:B002/m01); fifth arrow in the gaming set (quranic:root_001533:B016/m01); casting lots from the hand (quranic:root_001192:B004/m01); losing arrow in the draw (quranic:root_000458:B019/m01); winning lot that comes out for its owner (quranic:root_001186:B001/m02); gambling by deceptive victory (quranic:root_001255:B007/m01); defeating a gambler by blocking what was sought (quranic:root_000313:B007/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:2 (رَبِّ); 10:36 (عَلِيمٌۢ); 10:23 (أَنفُسِ); 10:61 (تُفِيضُ); 10:31 (يُدَبِّرُ); 10:64 (فَوْزُ); 10:5 (قَمَرَ); 10:59 (حَرَامًا).
- Synthesis: The cluster supplies the equipment, marked pieces, casting action, named share, and opposed outcomes of a complete lot game. It materializes the surah's contrast between disclosed knowledge and conjectural allocation: human hands cast devices that arbitrarily make winners and losers, whereas provision, lawful classification, and final settlement are presented as measured rather than wagered.

### S18. Whole-Surah - Advance Payment and Deferred Settlement
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: Capital is advanced into a forward sale, goods or rights are handed over, parties bid for increase or transfer the sale, and the transaction can be rescinded, recovered, or realized as loss.
- Active motifs: capital paid in advance (quranic:root_000733:B005/m01); forward sale on credit (quranic:root_000737:B005/m01); delivery by hand (quranic:root_001693:B007/m01); bidding for an increase (quranic:root_000657:B004/m01); assignment or resale of a transaction (quranic:root_001684:B014/m01); rescission of sale or exchange (quranic:root_000544:B011/m01); recovery and mutual return in sale (quranic:root_000555:B004/m01); commercial loss (quranic:root_000409:B002/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:30 (أَسْلَفَتْ، مَوْلَىٰ، رُدُّ); 10:25 (سَّلَٰمِ); 10:37 (يَدَيْ); 10:26 (زِيَادَةٌ); 10:4 (مَرْجِعُ); 10:45 (خَسِرَ).
- Synthesis: Advance, obligation, handover, bidding, transfer, rescission, and loss form one deferred commercial process. This scene materializes the surah's primary return-and-account reading: what a self sends ahead resembles capital committed before delivery, and the final return is the settlement at which the transaction's real gain or loss becomes nontransferable.

### S19. Whole-Surah - Consecration, Standing, Circuit, and Offering
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: A worshipper intends a sacred visit, enters consecration and its special garment, stands at the appointed site, circles a focal place, sends an animal offering to the sanctuary, and completes the rite.
- Active motifs: intending a visit and rite (quranic:root_001044:B004/m01); entering ritual consecration (quranic:root_000313:B004/m01); consecrated worshipper's garment (quranic:root_000313:B010/m01); standing at Arafat (quranic:root_001002:B007/m01); object or place circumambulated (quranic:root_000499:B006/m01); sacrificial animal sent as an offering (quranic:root_000096:B003/m01); gift directed to the sanctuary (quranic:root_001583:B005/m01); completion of rites (quranic:root_001237:B004/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:16 (عُمُرًا); 10:59 (حَرَامًا); 10:45 (يَتَعَارَفُ); 10:25 (دَارِ); 10:92 (بَدَنِ); 10:108 (ٱهْتَدَىٰ); 10:54 (قُضِىَ).
- Synthesis: Intention, consecration, clothing, standing, circuit, offering, and completion define an embodied rite with a beginning and terminus. It supports the surah's primary call to exclusive orientation and usefully pressures unauthorized lawful-forbidden classification: worship is not an improvised label but a directed sequence in which body, place, gift, and completion remain ordered toward one sanctuary.

### S20. Whole-Surah - Pot, Fire, Roast, and Serving Bowl
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: A cauldron is set up, a cooking pot is managed with a heat-protecting cloth, food meets fire until fat drips and smoke rises, and the result is placed in an eating vessel.
- Active motifs: cauldron standing on its support (quranic:root_000546:B016/m01); cooking pot and its cook (quranic:root_001205:B007/m01); cloth used to lower a pot from heat (quranic:root_000248:B007/m01); meeting fire and roasting (quranic:root_000879:B001/m01); roast with dripping fat (quranic:root_000787:B005/m01); smoke and odor of roasting (quranic:root_001199:B003/m01); vessel from which food is eaten (quranic:root_000043:B013/m01); bowl collecting food or water (quranic:root_001222:B004/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:2 (رَجُلٍ); 10:5 (قَدَّرَ); 10:24 (جَعَلْ، يَأْكُلُ); 10:87 (صَّلَوٰةَ); 10:11 (شَّرَّ); 10:26 (قَتَرٌ); 10:98 (قَرْيَةٌ).
- Synthesis: Cookware, heat handling, roasting, sensory emission, and serving vessel form a complete preparation sequence. This materially reframes the surah's primary food-and-taste contrast: provision and consequence are not only consumed but prepared and served, making wholesome sustenance and punitive ingestion opposing forms of what is made ready for the recipient.

### S21. Whole-Surah - Building and Drawing from a Well
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: A new water-holding cavity is cut, timber supports the draw point, a tightly twisted rope carries a handled bucket, drawers alternate turns, a sounding stone measures depth, and water enters the opening.
- Active motifs: newly dug well (quranic:root_000090:B008/m01); cavity or well that retains water (quranic:root_000434:B011/m01); well timber and water-drawer's station (quranic:root_001000:B004/m01); tightly twisted rope (quranic:root_001414:B005/m01); bucket with one loop handle (quranic:root_000737:B011/m01); bucket's ear or handle (quranic:root_000741:B008/m01); alternating turns at drawing water (quranic:root_000433:B011/m01); sounding stone used to measure a well (quranic:root_000543:B006/m01); water appearing and entering (quranic:root_001458:B002/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:4 (يَبْدَؤُا۟); 10:3 (خَلَقَ، عَرْشِ); 10:12 (مَرَّ); 10:25 (سَّلَٰمِ); 10:31 (سَّمْعَ); 10:6 (ٱخْتِلَٰفِ); 10:100 (رِّجْسَ); 10:24 (مَآءٍ).
- Synthesis: Excavation, support, rope, bucket, turn-taking, depth measurement, and incoming water form one piece of working infrastructure. The scene materializes the surah's primary reading of provision and disclosure as routed access: hidden water becomes available through an ordered aperture and shared mechanism, pressing against claims of self-sufficient possession.

### S22. Whole-Surah - Pregnancy, Milking, and Thickened Milk
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: Pregnancy becomes visible in a she-camel, the udder fills, massage draws milk, fingertips complete a small milking, the flow continues, fresh milk is taken, and heat thickens it.
- Active motifs: visible pregnancy in camel or ewe (quranic:root_000531:B010/m01); pregnant she-camel (quranic:root_000884:B018/m01); udder filling (quranic:root_000555:B007/m01); massage that draws milk (quranic:root_001416:B001/m01); milking by the fingertips (quranic:root_001428:B001/m01); continuous flow of milk (quranic:root_000563:B006/m01); milk taken fresh at once (quranic:root_000860:B012/m01); milk thickened by heating (quranic:root_001108:B007/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:46 (نُرِيَ); 10:42 (صُّمَّ); 10:30 (رُدُّ); 10:94 (مُمْتَرِينَ); 10:87 (مِصْرَ); 10:47 (رَّسُولٌ); 10:32 (تُصْرَفُ); 10:71 (غُمَّةً).
- Synthesis: Gestation, bodily filling, extraction, flow, freshness, and processing form a complete husbandry sequence. It materially supports the surah's primary questions about who provides and brings life through changing states: sustenance emerges through a living body over time, then still requires skilled reception and transformation before it becomes retained food.

### S23. P1-P2-P4-P6 - Causal Bridge from Inscription to Authentication
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Bridge (causal sequence and role progression): communication takes durable written form, is assembled and read as a document, becomes testimony and a registrable trace under live witness, and is later tested by readers in mutual study.
- Active motifs: communication as writing or engraving (quranic:root_001633:B003/m01); written document (quranic:root_001283:B002/m01); joining parts into a text (quranic:root_001283:B001/m01); entering a name in a register or witness roll (quranic:root_001283:B004/m01); informed testimony (quranic:root_000822:B002/m01); reading to another and mutual study (quranic:root_001210:B002/m02).
- Ayah anchors: 10:1-2 (كِتَٰبِ، أَوْحَيْ); 10:15 (قُرْءَانٍ، يُوحَىٰٓ); 10:37 (قُرْءَانُ، كِتَٰبِ); 10:61 (شُهُودًا، قُرْءَانٍ، كِتَٰبٍ); 10:94 (يَقْرَءُ، كِتَٰبَ).
- Synthesis: The bridge supports the surah's primary provenance reading by giving continuity distinct documentary roles without assigning any of them authorship. Inscription preserves form, testimony preserves occurrence, the register preserves accountable identity, and mutual reading preserves transmissible verification.

### S24. P1-P3-P6 - Shared-Invariant Bridge of Permission-Gated Agency
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Bridge (shared invariant and contrast): an intercessor, a classifier of provision, and a would-be compeller of belief each reaches the same authorization boundary; joining a claim, assigning a status, or producing belief cannot be self-licensed.
- Active motifs: authorization and licensed entry (quranic:root_000022:B004/m01); intercessor joining another's case (quranic:root_000802:B002/m01); arbitrary exercise of judgment over another (quranic:root_001272:B010/m01); forcing another into a disliked act (quranic:root_001295:B003/m01); belief settling in the heart (quranic:root_000054:B002/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:3 (شَفِيعٍ، إِذْنِهِ); 10:59 (قُلْ، أَذِنَ); 10:99-100 (تُكْرِهُ، ءَامَنَ، تُؤْمِنَ، إِذْنِ).
- Synthesis: Permission fixes role competence rather than merely approving a completed act. This supports the surah's causal-priority reading and reframes noncoercion: force cannot replace authorization in producing belief any more than assertion can replace authorization in classifying provision.

### S25. P1-P3-P5-P6 - Temporal Bridge Before and After Closure
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Bridge (causal sequence and contrast): premature demand tries to pull a promised outcome forward, the fixed term refuses advance or delay, drowning overtakes a declaration of belief after closure, and earlier belief uncovers punishment and opens a further interval.
- Active motifs: premature hastening (quranic:root_000987:B001/m01); promised horizon (quranic:root_001662:B001/m01); fixed temporal limit (quranic:root_000016:B001/m01); postponement (quranic:root_000019:B002/m01); forward advance (quranic:root_001207:B004/m01); overtaking and reaching (quranic:root_000471:B001/m01); drowning in water (quranic:root_001080:B001/m01); belief settling in the heart (quranic:root_000054:B002/m01); benefit against harm (quranic:root_001536:B001/m01); removal of a covering (quranic:root_001302:B001/m01); appointed time (quranic:root_000382:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:11 (أَجَلُ، يُعَجِّلُ، ٱسْتِعْجَالَ); 10:48-51 (وَعْدُ، أَجَلٌ، يَسْتَـْٔخِرُ، يَسْتَقْدِمُ، يَسْتَعْجِلُ، ءَامَن); 10:90 (أَدْرَكَ، غَرَقُ، ءَامَن); 10:98 (ءَامَنَتْ، نَفَعَ، كَشَفْ، حِينٍ).
- Synthesis: Timing is part of causation, not empty delay. The contrast supports the surah's timed-response reading: the same declaration that cannot reverse an outcome once it has overtaken its speaker can still remove a threatened covering when it arrives before closure.

### S26. P1-P2-P5-P6 - Repeated-Scene Bridge of Crisis, Release, and Allegiance
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Bridge (repeated scene signature and reversal): bodily harm and maritime enclosure narrow action into an exclusive call; release reopens movement, where the individual passes on and the passengers transgress, while historical rescues and the closing causal rule identify the only source able to uncover harm.
- Active motifs: contact that leaves an effect (quranic:root_001423:B004/m01); harm and deficiency (quranic:root_000907:B001/m01); crisis call (quranic:root_000478:B001/m01); physical encirclement (quranic:root_000372:B001/m01); exclusive devotion (quranic:root_000430:B004/m01); removal of a covering (quranic:root_001302:B001/m01); passing onward (quranic:root_001414:B001/m01); exceeding the limit (quranic:root_000699:B001/m01); transgressive overreach (quranic:root_000138:B003/m01); escape by separation (quranic:root_001476:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:12 (مَسَّ، ضُّرُّ، دَعَا، كَشَفْ، مَرَّ، مُسْرِفِينَ); 10:22-23 (أُحِيطَ، دَعَوُا، مُخْلِصِينَ، أَنجَيْ، يَبْغُونَ); 10:73, 10:86, 10:92 (نَجَّيْ، نَجِّنَا، نُنَجِّيكَ); 10:107 (يَمْسَسْ، ضُرٍّ، كَاشِفَ).
- Synthesis: Pressure concentrates allegiance but does not by itself make allegiance durable; release is the second test. The bridge supports the surah's exclusive-dependence reading while usefully pressing it: rescue becomes revelatory through the direction taken after enclosure is removed.

### S27. P1-P3-P5-P6 - Contrast Bridge of Authorized Succession and Failed Substitution
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Bridge (contrast and role reversal): received discourse cannot be replaced, another bearer or ransom cannot discharge a self's consequence, a rescued community can be installed in a vacated historical position, and the messenger cannot become custodian of another self.
- Active motifs: one thing standing in another's place (quranic:root_000095:B001/m01); one bearer discharging or standing for another (quranic:root_000244:B002/m01); ransom made a substitute for its beneficiary (quranic:root_001136:B001/m01); successor replacing another (quranic:root_000433:B001/m01); custodian sufficient for an entrusted affair (quranic:root_001681:B006/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:14-15 (خَلَٰٓئِفَ، بَدِّلْ، أُبَدِّلَ); 10:52, 10:54 (تُجْزَوْنَ، ٱفْتَدَتْ); 10:73 (خَلَٰٓئِفَ); 10:108 (وَكِيلٍ).
- Synthesis: Substitution is role-governed rather than uniformly rejected. Authorized succession changes the occupant while preserving the governing claim; counterfeit discourse, exchanged liability, and transferred agency instead try to change the claim by changing its bearer. The contrast sharpens the surah's primary account of nontransferable provenance and responsibility.

### S28. Whole-Surah - Making and Provisioning a Travel Waterskin
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: Hide is cut into side panels, joined with fine stitches, sealed and conditioned with water and clay, finished as a light canteen, filled for travel, and exposed to a failure mode that spoils it.
- Active motifs: cutting hide for repair and waterskin manufacture (quranic:root_001150:B001/m01); side panels cut from hide (quranic:root_001536:B002/m01); fine stitching of a waterskin (quranic:root_000865:B004/m01); sealing stitches and improving taste with water and clay (quranic:root_000783:B013/m01); light travel canteen (quranic:root_000987:B004/m01); stored food or water and its travel container (quranic:root_000657:B005/m01); moon exposure spoiling a waterskin (quranic:root_001255:B006/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:4 (شَرَابٌ); 10:5 (قَمَرَ); 10:11 (يُعَجِّلُ); 10:17 (ٱفْتَرَىٰ); 10:18 (يَنفَعُ); 10:26 (زِيَادَةٌ); 10:61 (أَصْغَرَ).
- Synthesis: Cutting, joining, sealing, filling, carrying, and spoilage form one provisioning chain. It materializes the surah's primary account of routed provision: supplied water remains usable only through a sound vessel whose panels and seams hold, while damage to that containing mechanism can waste what has been given.

### S29. Whole-Surah - Suppuration, Recovery, and Relapse
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: A lesion emerges, swells beyond its boundary, gathers pus, corrupts into an ulcer, then either resolves through recovery and convalescence or returns after improvement.
- Active motifs: boil or lesion emerging from the body (quranic:root_000400:B004/m01); wound swelling and spreading into corruption (quranic:root_000138:B004/m01); pus gathered in a wound or abscess (quranic:root_000282:B003/m01); ulcer spoiled by suppuration (quranic:root_000025:B011/m01); recovery from illness (quranic:root_000099:B003/m01); convalescent improvement after illness (quranic:root_001397:B012/m01); relapse of a wound or illness (quranic:root_001096:B004/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:3 (أَرْضَ); 10:23 (يَبْغُ); 10:24 (مَثَلُ); 10:31 (يُخْرِجُ); 10:41 (بَرِىٓءٌ، بَرِيٓـُٔونَ); 10:57 (جَآءَتْ); 10:107 (غَفُورُ).
- Synthesis: The bodily sequence gives the surah's primary healing reading a resistant pathology rather than a generic ailment. Corruption expands, accumulates matter, and can return after apparent improvement, so treatment of the chest entails an actual reversal of spreading damage rather than a momentary change of label.

### S30. Whole-Surah - Drawing the Bow and Missing the Target
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: An archer reaches into the quiver, tests the bow by drawing its string, pulls to the limit, selects a target arrow, and releases a shot that either falls beyond the mark or veers away without even scratching it.
- Active motifs: reaching to the quiver for an arrow (quranic:root_000544:B010/m01); testing a bow by drawing its string (quranic:root_000526:B003/m01); drawing a bow to its limit (quranic:root_001080:B004/m01); small target arrow (quranic:root_001199:B006/m01); arrow overshooting and falling behind the target (quranic:root_000458:B018/m01); arrow deviating without a scratch (quranic:root_001464:B005/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:3 (يُدَبِّرُ); 10:4 (مَرْجِعُ); 10:18 (تُنَبِّـُٔ); 10:21 (أَذَقْ); 10:26 (قَتَرٌ); 10:90 (غَرَقُ).
- Synthesis: Retrieval, testing, full draw, release, and two distinct misses form a complete shot cycle. The scene usefully pressures the surah's primary causal account of guidance and harm: possession of an instrument, directed effort, and maximum force still do not make intention identical with an effect at the target.

### S31. Whole-Surah - Concealed Gestation, Delivery, and Recovery
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: A fetus grows concealed in the womb, birth begins, a hands-first presentation marks emergence, a midwife receives the newborn, afterbirth and postpartum blood follow, and the mother rises from the condition.
- Active motifs: fetus concealed in the abdomen (quranic:root_000266:B007/m01); womb as the growing child's vessel (quranic:root_000552:B003/m01); onset and occurrence of birth (quranic:root_001683:B003/m01); hands-first presentation at delivery (quranic:root_001630:B010/m01); midwife receiving the emerging child (quranic:root_001198:B007/m01); afterbirth and traces accompanying delivery (quranic:root_000822:B006/m01); childbirth and postpartum bleeding (quranic:root_001533:B005/m01); recovery from childbirth or illness (quranic:root_001042:B011/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:9 (جَنَّٰتِ); 10:15 (نَفْسِ); 10:18 (تَعَٰلَىٰ); 10:21 (رَحْمَةً); 10:26 (وُجُوهَ); 10:61 (شُهُودًا); 10:68 (وَلَدًا); 10:87 (قِبْلَةً).
- Synthesis: Concealment, growth, bodily emergence, skilled reception, discharge, and recovery define a complete transition into visible life. It materializes the surah's primary life-giving reading as a staged passage through dependence: life is formed out of sight, brought across a bodily threshold, received by another, and sustained through the mother's recovery.

### S32. Whole-Surah - Tethering a Living Mount at a Grave
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: A dead owner is concealed in a shroud and grave understood as a house, while a living camel or mount is fastened beside that grave and left tethered until it dies.
- Active motifs: grave as the dead person's house (quranic:root_000166:B007/m01); concealment of the dead in shroud and grave (quranic:root_000266:B009/m01); tethering loop or fastening for an animal (quranic:root_000020:B002/m01); camel or mount bound at its owner's grave until death (quranic:root_000153:B005/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:9 (جَنَّٰتِ); 10:30 (تَبْلُوا۟); 10:87 (أَخِي، بُيُوتًا).
- Synthesis: Burial place, tether, living mount, and resulting death make one funerary practice. It usefully pressures the surah's primary claims about exclusive devotion, provision, and return: attachment to a dead owner consumes a living provision in a second death, although neither grave nor rite can restore either life.

### S33. Whole-Surah - Arrival, Greeting, and Hospitable Settlement
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: A visitor approaches in a fitting manner, is welcomed among familiar people rather than strangers, exchanges a prayer of life and peace, can receive that greeting through an intermediary, and settles in a place suited to the guest.
- Active motifs: approaching an affair by its fitting way (quranic:root_000009:B003/m01); welcome into spacious and familiar company (quranic:root_000064:B005/m01); greeting and its return as a prayer for life and peace (quranic:root_000383:B007/m01); conveying a peace greeting to another (quranic:root_001211:B006/m01); place agreeing with its occupant as a pleasant lodging (quranic:root_001525:B011/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:9 (نَّعِيمِ); 10:10 (تَحِيَّتُ); 10:24 (أَتَىٰ، أَهْلُ); 10:94 (يَقْرَءُ).
- Synthesis: Approach, welcome, reciprocal greeting, transmission, and fitting lodging form a complete hospitality scene. It materializes the Garden's greeting and the House of Peace as inhabited social relations: peace is enacted through admission, recognized company, reciprocal speech, and a place in which the received person can remain.

### S34. Whole-Surah - Assessing a Wound and Settling Blood Money
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: A bodily wound creates a legally assessed obligation, compensation is fixed for the injury, the responsible kin group pays blood money, and the payment can replace retaliation.
- Active motifs: wound as a bodily injury (quranic:root_001316:B003/m01); obligatory compensation assessed for a wound (quranic:root_001488:B003/m01); blood money and its payment by the liable kin group (quranic:root_001036:B004/m01); blood money accepted instead of retaliation (quranic:root_001119:B002/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:15 (غَيْرِ); 10:16 (تَعْقِلُ); 10:64 (كَلِمَٰتِ); 10:73 (مُنذَرِينَ).
- Synthesis: Injury, assessment, collective liability, payment, and waived retaliation form one authorized legal settlement. The scene usefully pressures the surah's primary account of final liability: substitution can discharge a worldly injury when the governing order authorizes it, clarifying by contrast why an unlicensed ransom cannot transfer the final claim away from its bearer.

### S35. Whole-Surah - The Charm That Claims to Turn a Heart
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: A sorceress attaches or employs a bead and binding charm said to capture judgment, turn one face toward another, and divert the heart from what it intended.
- Active motifs: sorceress's bead claimed to turn a person's face (quranic:root_001198:B016/m01); spell, charm, or bead claimed to bind a person or judgment (quranic:root_000018:B004/m01); bead claimed to divert the heart (quranic:root_000860:B009/m01); turning a person away from a true direction (quranic:root_000041:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:24 (أَخَذَتِ); 10:32 (تُصْرَفُ); 10:34 (تُؤْفَكُ); 10:87 (قِبْلَةً).
- Synthesis: Practitioner, object, binding operation, and claimed inward redirection form a compact magical mechanism. It materializes the sorcery contest and usefully pressures the surah's primary guidance reading: the charm claims an external shortcut from handled object to inward orientation, precisely where the surah denies that coercion can manufacture belief.

### S36. Whole-Surah - Estimating, Firing, and Joining Brickwork
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: A builder estimates the required brick count, laborers prepare straw-tempered clay by hand, bricks are fired in their kiln, and the finished units are joined into a house or wall.
- Active motifs: estimating how many bricks a building requires (quranic:root_000950:B007/m01); straw-tempered building clay (quranic:root_000760:B004/m01); brick-firing kiln or chamber (quranic:root_001669:B005/m01); manual laborers working in digging and clay (quranic:root_001046:B006/m01); building by joining parts into a house or wall (quranic:root_000156:B001/m01).
- Ayah anchors: 10:45 (سَاعَةً); 10:46 (نَتَوَفَّيَ); 10:81 (عَمَلَ); 10:88 (ٱطْمِسْ); 10:93 (بَنِىٓ).
- Synthesis: Estimate, material preparation, hand labor, firing, and assembly form a complete construction process. It materializes the surah's primary scene of houses reoriented under pressure: durable communal space depends on measured supply, transformed material, coordinated work, and joined units before it can sustain worship.
